storyBody:
动物园奇遇

阿婆今日去咗动物园，想睇老虎。
(aa3 po4 gam1 jat6 heoi3 zo2 dung6 mat6 jyun4, soeng2 tai2 lou5 fu2.)
(Grandma went to the zoo today, wanting to see the tigers.)

点知老虎瞓晒晏觉，睬都唔睬佢。
(dim2 zi1 lou5 fu2 fan3晒 aan3 gaau3, coi2 dou1 m4 coi2 keoi5.)
(But the tigers were all napping, not paying her any attention.)

阿婆嬲嬲哋，攞咗支雪条喂老虎。
(aa3 po4 nau1 nau1 dei2, lo2 zo2 zi1 syut3 tiu2 wai3 lou5 fu2.)
(Grandma got a little annoyed and took out an ice pop to feed the tiger.)

老虎舔舔脷，好鬼开心咁样！
(lou5 fu2 tim2 tim2 lei5, hou2 gwai2 hoi1 sam1 gam2 joeng2!)
(The tiger licked its tongue, looking very happy!)

原来老虎都锺意食甜嘢㗎！
(jyun4 loi4 lou5 fu2 dou1 zung1 ji3 sik6 tim4 je5 gaa3!)
(Turns out tigers also like to eat sweet things!)

賣魚勝嘅秘密武器

阿婆成日去街市買餸，最鍾意搵賣魚勝。
(aa3 po4 sing4 jat1 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 sung3, zeoi3 zung1 ji3 wan2 maai6 yu2 sing3.)
(Grandma always goes to the market to buy groceries, and she likes to find Fishmonger Sing the most.)

佢啲魚新鮮又生猛，唔係個個檔口都有。
(keoi5 di1 yu2 san1 sin1 jau6 sang1 maang5, m4 hai6 go3 go3 dong3 hau2 dou1 jau5.)
(His fish are fresh and lively, not every stall has them.)

有一日，阿婆終於忍唔住問佢嘅秘訣。
(jau5 jat1 jat6, aa3 po4 zung1 jyu1 jan2 m4 zyu6 man6 keoi5 ge3 bei3 kyut3.)
(One day, Grandma finally couldn't help but ask him his secret.)

賣魚勝笑瞇瞇咁話：「我每日夜晚都同啲魚講晚安㗎！」
(maai6 yu2 sing3 siu3 mei1 mei1 gam2 waa6: "ngo5 mui5 jat6 je5 maan5 dou1 tung4 di1 yu2 gong2 maan5 on1 gaa3!")
(Fishmonger Sing smiled and said, "I tell the fish goodnight every night!")

原來，溫柔嘅問候就係保持魚仔活力嘅秘密！
(jyun4 loi4, wan1 jau4 ge3 man6 hau6 zau6 hai6 bou2 ci4 yu2 zai2 wut6 lik6 ge3 bei3 mat6!)
(Turns out, a gentle greeting is the secret to keeping the fish lively!)

瞓覺豬嘅一日

阿喵起身伸個懶腰，諗住今日又係嘆世界嘅一日。
(aa3 miu1 hei2 san1 san1 go3 laan5 jiu1, nam2 zyu6 gam1 jat6 jau6 hai6 taan3 sai3 gaai3 ge3 jat1 jat6.)
(The cat woke up and stretched lazily, thinking today would be another day of enjoying the world.)

佢跳上窗台，曬住暖笠笠嘅太陽，睇住樓下嘅阿婆跳緊廣場舞。
(keoi5 tiu3 soeng5 cung1 toi4, saai3 zyu6 nuun5 lap1 lap1 ge3 taai3 joeng4, tai2 zyu6 lau4 haa6 ge3 aa3 po4 tiu3 gan2 gwong2 coeng4 mou5.)
(It jumped onto the windowsill, basking in the warm sunshine, watching the old woman dancing the plaza dance downstairs.)

突然，佢見到隻肥嘟嘟嘅曱甴，即刻精神晒，準備捉佢嚟玩。
(dat6 jin4, keoi5 gin3 dou2 zek3 fei4 du1 du1 ge3 gaat6 zaat2, zik1 hak1 zing1 san4 saai3, zeon2 bei6 zuk1 keoi5 lai4 waan2.)
(Suddenly, it saw a chubby cockroach, immediately perked up, and prepared to catch it for fun.)

玩咗一陣，佢覺得肚餓，就喵喵叫，示意主人畀嘢佢食。
(waan2 zo2 jat1 zan6, keoi5 gok3 dak1 tou5 ngo6, zau6 miu1 miu1 giu3, si3 ji3 zyu2 jan4 bei2 je5 keoi5 sik6.)
(After playing for a while, it felt hungry and meowed, signaling its owner to give it food.)

食飽之後，佢又跳返上床，繼續瞓晏覺，真係寫意。
(sik6 baau2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 jau6 tiu3 faan1 soeng5 cong4, gai3 zuk1 fan3 aan3 gaau3, zan1 hai6 se2 ji3.)
(After eating, it jumped back onto the bed and continued to nap, truly living the good life.)

車廂露營記

阿婆話齋，人生就係一場大冒險。
(aa3 po4 waa6 zaai1, jan4 sang1 zau6 hai6 jat1 coeng4 daai6 mou6 him2.)
(Grandma always says life is one big adventure.)

我一時興起，決定喺架車度露營，慳返啲酒店錢。
(ngo5 jat1 si4 hing1 hei2, kyut3 ding6 hai2 gaa3 ce1 dou6 lou6 jing4, haan1 faan1 di1 zau2 dim3 cin2.)
(On a whim, I decided to camp in my car, saving some money on hotels.)

點知半夜落大雨，好似有成隊鼓樂團喺車頂打鼓咁。
(dim2 zi1 bun3 je6 lok6 daai6 jyu5, hou2 ci5 jau5 sing4 deoi2 gu2 ngok6 tyun4 hai2 ce1 ding2 daa2 gu2 gam2.)
(Unexpectedly, it rained heavily in the middle of the night, like a whole drum troupe was drumming on the car roof.)

我嚇到醒晒，即刻覺得自己好似罐頭沙甸魚。
(ngo5 haak3 dou3 seng2 saai3, zik1 hak1 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hou2 ci5 gun3 tau4 saa1 din1 jyu2.)
(I was so scared I woke up completely, and immediately felt like a can of sardines.)

第二朝起身，見到太陽伯伯笑咪咪，仲有隻雀仔喺車窗邊唱歌。
(dai6 ji6 zaau1 hei2 san1, gin3 dou3 taai3 joeng4 baak3 baak3 siu3 mi1 mi1, zung6 jau5 zek3 zoek3 zai2 hai2 ce1 coeng1 bin1 coeng3 go1.)
(The next morning when I woke up, I saw the sun smiling, and a bird was singing by the car window.)

雖然瞓得唔係咁好，但係都幾得意嘅回憶。
(seoi1 jin4 fan3 dak1 m4 hai6 gam3 hou2, daan6 hai6 dou1 gei2 dak1 ji3 ge3 wui4 yik1.)
(Although I didn't sleep very well, it's still a pretty interesting memory.)

瞓到日上三竿

[瞓到日上三竿]
(fan3 dou3 jat6 soeng5 saam1 gaan1)
(Slept until the sun was high in the sky.)

阿咪擘大眼，伸個懶腰，喵喵叫咗兩聲。
[阿咪擘大眼，伸個懶腰，喵喵叫咗兩聲。]
(aa3 mi1 maak3 daai6 ngaan5, san1 go3 laan5 jiu1, miu1 miu1 giu3 zo2 loeng5 sing1.)
(Ah Mi opened her big eyes, stretched lazily, and meowed twice.)

佢跳落梳化，行去廚房搵嘢食。
[佢跳落梳化，行去廚房搵嘢食。]
(keoi5 tiu3 lok6 so1 faa2, haang4 heoi3 cyu4 fong2 wan2 je5 sik6.)
(She jumped off the sofa and went to the kitchen to find something to eat.)

食飽飽之後，佢又跳上窗台曬太陽，嘆世界。
[食飽飽之後，佢又跳上窗台曬太陽，嘆世界。]
(sik6 baau2 baau2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 jau6 tiu3 soeng5 coeng1 toi4 saai3 taai3 joeng4, taan3 sai3 gaai3.)
(After eating her fill, she jumped onto the windowsill to sunbathe and enjoy life.)

晏晝嘅時候，佢同啲塵玩咗一陣，仲差啲打爛阿媽嘅花樽。
[晏晝嘅時候，佢同啲塵玩咗一陣，仲差啲打爛阿媽嘅花樽。]
(aan3 zau3 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 tung4 di1 can4 waan2 zo2 jat1 zan6, zung6 caa1 di1 daa2 laan6 aa3 maa1 ge3 faa1 zeon1.)
(In the afternoon, she played with some dust and almost broke Mom's vase.)

夜晚，佢就瞓喺主人嘅腳邊，甜甜咁瞓覺。
[夜晚，佢就瞓喺主人嘅腳邊，甜甜咁瞓覺。]
(je6 maan5, keoi5 zau6 fan3 hai2 zyu2 jan4 ge3 goek3 bin1, tim4 tim4 gam2 fan3 gaau3.)
(At night, she slept sweetly at her owner's feet.)

瞓覺貓嘅一日

阿花擘大眼，伸咗個懶腰，喵喵叫咗兩聲。
(aa3 faa1 maak3 daai6 ngaan5, san1 zo2 go3 laan5 jiu1, miu1 miu1 giu3 zo2 loeng5 seng1.)
(Ah Fa opened her big eyes, stretched languidly, and meowed twice.)

佢跳落梳化，輕輕咁行去廚房。
(keoi5 tiu3 lok6 so1 faa2, hing1 hing1 gam2 haang4 heoi3 cyu4 fong2.)
(She jumped down from the sofa, and walked gently to the kitchen.)

婆婆已經準備好咗香噴噴嘅魚仔俾佢。
(po4 po2 ji5 ging1 zyun2 bei6 hou2 zo2 hoeng1 pan1 pan1 ge3 yu2 zai2 bei2 keoi5.)
(Grandma had already prepared a fragrant and delicious fish for her.)

食飽飽之後，阿花就走咗去花園捉蝴蝶。
(sik6 baau2 baau2 zi1 hau6, aa3 faa1 zau6 zau2 zo2 heoi3 faa1 jyun4 zuk1 wu4 dip6.)
(After eating her fill, Ah Fa went to the garden to catch butterflies.)

黃昏嗰陣，佢瞓喺窗邊，睇住太陽落山，好舒服呀！
(wong4 fan1 go2 zan6, keoi5 fan3 hai2 coeng1 bin1, tai2 zyu6 taai3 joeng4 lok6 saan1, hou2 syu1 fuk6 aa3!)
(At dusk, she slept by the window, watching the sunset, so comfortable!)

失而復得嘅風箏

細蚊仔阿明最鍾意就係喺山頂放風箏。
(sai3 man1 zai2 aa3 ming4 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 zau6 hai6 hai2 saan1 deng2 fong3 fung1 zeng1.)
(Little boy Ah Ming loved flying kites on the hilltop the most.)

但係打仗嗰陣，啲飛機飛嚟飛去，阿明驚到匿埋咗。
(daan6 hai6 daa2 zoeng3 go2陣，di1 fei1 gei1 fei1 lai4 fei1 heoi3，aa3 ming4 ging1 dou3 nik1 maai4 zo2.)
(But during the war, with planes flying back and forth, Ah Ming was so scared he hid.)

戰後，佢再上山頂，發現自己嘅風箏仲喺度，只係爛咗少少。
(zin3 hau6, keoi5 zoi3 soeng5 saan1 deng2, faat3 jin6 zi6 gei2 ge3 fung1 zeng1 zung6 hai2 dou6, zi2 hai6 laan6 zo2 siu2 siu2.)
(After the war, he went up the hilltop again and found his kite was still there, only a little torn.)

阿明好開心，即刻攞返屋企，黐返好佢。
(aa3 ming4 hou2 hoi1 sam1, zik1 hak1 lo2 faan1 uk1 kei2, ci1 faan1 hou2 keoi5.)
(Ah Ming was very happy and immediately took it home to fix it.)

風箏再次飛上天空，就好似話俾大家聽，和平終於返嚟啦！
(fung1 zeng1 zoi3 ci3 fei1 soeng5 tin1 hung1, zau6 hou2 ci5 waa6 bei2 daai6 gaa1 teng1, wo4 ping4 zung1 jyu1 faan1 lai4 laa1!)
(The kite flew into the sky again, as if telling everyone that peace had finally returned!)

貓咪偷咗件披薩

有一日，阿強喺屋企煮咗一個大大塊嘅披薩。
(jau5 jat1 jat6, aa3 koeng4 hai2 uk1 kei2 zyu2 zo2 jat1 go3 daai6 daai6 faai3 ge3 pi1 saa3.)
(One day, Ah Keung made a big pizza at home.)

佢放低披薩去廚房門口等涼，點知屋企嘅貓咪小花瞄準咗，輕輕咁跳上枱。
(keoi5 fong3 dai1 pi1 saa3 heoi3 ceoi4 fong2 mun4 hau2 dang2 loeng4, dim2 zi1 uk1 kei2 ge3 maau1 mai1 siu2 faa1 miu4 zeon2 zo2, heng1 heng1 gam2 tiu3 soeng5 toi2.)
(He left the pizza by the kitchen door to cool, but the cat Siu Fa carefully jumped onto the table.)

小花用佢嘅爪仔，啪一聲，就將披薩拉到自己面前。
(siu2 faa1 jung6 keoi5 ge3 zaau2 zai2, paak3 jat1 seng1, zau6 zoeng1 pi1 saa3 laai1 dou3 zi6 gei2 min6 cin4.)
(Siu Fa used her paws, and *pop*, pulled the pizza right in front of her.)

阿強返嚟見到，眼珠差啲掉出嚟，喊住話：「喂！我啲芝士呢？」
(aa3 koeng4 faan1 lai4 gin3 dou3, ngaan5 zyu1 caa1 di1 diu6 ceot1 lai4, haam3 zyu6 waa6: "wai3! ngo5 di1 zi1 si6 ne1?")
(When Ah Keung came back, his eyes nearly popped out, shouting: "Hey! Where’s my cheese?")

小花就咬住披薩邊，慢慢走去沙發底，露出一副「你哋人類太慢啦」嘅得意表情。
(siu2 faa1 zau6 ngaau5 zyu6 pi1 saa3 bin1, maan6 maan6 zau2 heoi3 saa1 faat3 dai2, lou6 ceot1 jat1 fu6 "nei5 dei6 jan4 leoi5 taai3 maan6 laa1" ge3 dak1 ji3 biu2 cing4.)
(Siu Fa bit the edge of the pizza and slowly walked under the sofa, showing a cute expression that said, "You humans are too slow!")

阿強最後都只好攤手，搵嚟飲杯水，心諗：下次煮披薩，要鎖貓咪啦！
(aa3 koeng4 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 zi2 hou2 taan1 sau2, wan2 lai4 jam2 bui1 seoi2, sam1 nam2: haa6 ci3 zyu2 pi1 saa3, jiu3 so2 maau1 mai1 laa1!)
(In the end, Ah Keung just shrugged, grabbed a glass of water, thinking: Next time I make pizza, I need to lock the cat out!)

失而復得嘅幸運符

阿婆喺床頭櫃度搵返佢打仗嗰時嘅幸運符。
(aa3 po4 hai2 cong4 tau4 gwai2 dou6 wan2 faan1 keoi5 daa2 zoeng3 gwo2 si4 ge3 hang6 wan6 fu4.)
(Grandma found her lucky charm from the war on her bedside table.)

嗰個係一個用紅繩穿住嘅爛銅錢，上面仲有啲甩色嘅紅色油。
(go2 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 jung6 hung4 sing2 cyun1 zyu6 ge3 laan6 tung4 cin2, soeng6 min6 zung6 jau5 di1 lat1 sik1 ge3 hung4 sik1 jau4.)
(It was a worn copper coin strung with a red string, with some faded red paint on it.)

佢記得當年衝鋒陷陣， bullets 喺佢耳邊飛過，就係靠住呢個護身符。
(keoi5 gei3 dak1 dong1 nin4 cung1 fung1 haam6陣, bullets hai2 keoi5 ji5 bin1 fei1 gwo3, zau6 hai6 kaau3 zyu6 ni1 go3 wu6 san1 fu4.)
(She remembered charging into battle back then, bullets whizzing past her ears, and it was all thanks to this talisman.)

阿婆笑住摸住個銅錢，諗起當年嘅戰友同埋艱苦嘅日子。
(aa3 po4 siu3 zyu6 mo2 zyu6 go3 tung4 cin2, nam2 hei2 dong1 nin4 ge3 zin3 jau5 tung4 mai4 gaan1 fu2 ge3 jat6 zi2.)
(Grandma smiled, touching the copper coin, remembering her comrades and the hard days of the war.)

雖然日子艱難，但係佢哋都互相扶持，撐過咗難關。
(seoi1 jin4 jat6 zi2 gaan1 naan4, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 dou1 wu6 soeng1 fu4 ci4, caang1 gwo3 zo2 naan4 gwaan1.)
(Although the days were tough, they supported each other and got through the difficulties.)

而家見返呢個幸運符，阿婆覺得好似重新搵返自己嘅青春咁。
(ji4 gaa1 gin3 faan1 ni1 go3 hang6 wan6 fu4, aa3 po4 gok3 dak1 hou2 ci5 cung4 san1 wan2 faan1 zi6 gei2 ge3 cing1 ceon1 gam2.)
(Now, seeing this lucky charm again, Grandma felt like she had rediscovered her youth.)

開心嘅騎士

有個皇帝好鍾意食菠蘿包，但係佢唔想自己去買。
(jau5 go3 wong4 dai3 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 bo1 lo4 baau1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 m4 soeng2 zi6 gei2 heoi3 maai5.)
(There was an emperor who really loved to eat pineapple buns, but he didn't want to go buy them himself.)

佢就叫佢嘅騎士每日都要去街市幫佢買最新鮮嘅菠蘿包返嚟。
(keoi5 zau6 giu3 keoi5 ge3 ki5 si6 mui5 jat6 dou1 jiu3 heoi3 gaai1 si5 bong1 keoi5 maai5 zeoi3 san1 sin1 ge3 bo1 lo4 baau1 faan1 lai4.)
(So he ordered his knight to go to the market every day to buy the freshest pineapple buns for him.)

個騎士雖然覺得好奇怪，但係佢都係乖乖地照做。
(go3 ki5 si6 seoi1 jin4 gok3 dak1 hou2 kei4 gwaai3, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dou1 hai6 gwaai1 gwaai1 dei6 ziu3 zou6.)
(The knight, although he found it strange, obediently did as he was told.)

有一日，個騎士終於忍唔住問皇帝點解咁鍾意食菠蘿包。
(jau5 jat1 jat6, go3 ki5 si6 zung1 jyu1 jan2 m4 zyu6 man6 wong4 dai3 dim2 gaai2 gam3 zung1 ji3 sik6 bo1 lo4 baau1.)
(One day, the knight finally couldn't help but ask the emperor why he loved pineapple buns so much.)

皇帝笑住咁話：「因為食菠蘿包會令我覺得好開心呀嘛！」
(wong4 dai3 siu3 zyu6 gam3 waa6: "jan1 wai6 sik6 bo1 lo4 baau1 wui ling6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1 aa3 maa3!")
(The emperor smiled and said, "Because eating pineapple buns makes me feel happy!")

自此之後，個騎士每日買菠蘿包嘅時候，都會諗起皇帝個開心樣。
(zi6 ci2 zi1 hau6, go3 ki5 si6 mui5 jat6 maai5 bo1 lo4 baau1 ge3 si4 hau6, dou1 wui nam2 hei2 wong4 dai3 go3 hoi1 sam1 joeng2.)
(From then on, every time the knight bought pineapple buns, he would remember the emperor's happy face.)

佢發現，原來幫人帶嚟快樂，自己都會覺得好開心。
(keoi5 faat3 jin6, jyun4 lai4 bong1 jan4 daai3 lai4 faai3 lok6, zi6 gei2 dou1 wui gok3 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.)
(He discovered that bringing happiness to others also made him feel happy.)

捉風記

阿婆話：「風係捉唔住㗎，傻仔！」
(aa3 po4 waa6: "fung1 hai6 zuk1 m4 zyu6 gaa3, so4 zai2!")
(Grandma said, "You can't catch the wind, silly boy!")

小明唔信，攞住個大網，衝咗出去。
(siu2 ming4 m4 seon3, lo2 zyu6 go3 daai6 mong5, cung1 zo2 ceot1 heoi3.)
(Little Ming didn't believe her, grabbed a big net, and rushed outside.)

佢喺公園度跑嚟跑去，諗住一網打盡啲風。
(keoi5 hai2 gung1 jyun2 dou6 paau2 lai4 paau2 heoi3, nam2 zyu6 jat1 mong5 daa2 zeon6 di1 fung1.)
(He ran around in the park, thinking he could catch all the wind in one go.)

點知，佢淨係捉到一堆飄落嚟嘅樹葉。
(dim2 zi1, keoi5 zing6 hai6 zuk1 dou2 jat1 deoi1 piu1 lok6 lai4 ge3 syu6 jip6.)
(Turns out, he only caught a pile of fallen leaves.)

阿婆笑住行埋嚟，攞咗一片樹葉放喺小明嘅手心。
(aa3 po4 siu3 zyu6 haang4 maai4 lai4, lo2 zo2 jat1 pin3 syu6 jip6 fong3 hai2 siu2 ming4 ge3 sau2 sam1.)
(Grandma walked over smiling, took a leaf and placed it in Little Ming's palm.)

「風雖然睇唔到，但係佢令到樹葉識飛呀。」
("fung1 seoi1 jin4 tai2 m4 dou2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 ling6 dou3 syu6 jip6 sik1 fei1 aa3.")
("Although you can't see the wind, it makes the leaves fly.")

小明望住片樹葉，終於明白，有啲嘢唔係一定要捉住嘅。
(siu2 ming4 mong6 zyu6 pin3 syu6 jip6, zung1 jyu1 ming4 baak6, jau5 di1 je5 m4 hai6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zuk1 zyu6 ge3.)
(Little Ming looked at the leaf and finally understood that some things don't need to be caught.)

教婆婆講英文

我細細個就鍾意教婆婆講英文。
(ngo5 sai3 sai3 go3 zau6 zung1 ji3 gaau3 po4 po2 gong2 jing1 man2.)
(When I was little, I loved teaching Grandma to speak English.)

婆婆成日笑我發音唔正，但係佢都好努力咁學。
(po4 po2 seng4 jat6 siu3 ngo5 faat3 jam1 m4 zeng3, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dou1 hou2 nu5 lik6 gam2 hok6.)
(Grandma always laughed at my pronunciation being off, but she still tried hard to learn.)

有一日，有個鬼佬問路，婆婆居然用流利嘅英文答佢！
(jau5 jat1 jat6, jau5 go3 gwai2 lou2 man6 lou6, po4 po2 geoi1 jin4 yung6 lau4 lei6 ge3 jing1 man2 daap3 keoi5!)
(One day, a foreigner asked for directions, and Grandma actually answered him in fluent English!)

我開心到跳起，婆婆仲 wink 咗我一下，真係威水！
(ngo5 hoi1 sam1 dou3 tiu3 hei2, po4 po2 zung6 wink zo2 ngo5 jat1 haa5, zan1 hai6 wai1 seoi2!)
(I was so happy I jumped up, and Grandma even winked at me, so cool!)

原來教人嘅快樂，係咁樣㗎！

(dim2 zi1 daa2 hoi1 faan6 hap6, lei5 min6 ging2 jin4 hai6 jat1 zek3 sik1 gong2 je5 ge3 gai1 zai2!)
(Who knew that when I opened my lunchbox, there was actually a chick inside that could talk!)

佢眼濕濕咁望住我，話：「唔好食我呀，我識跳舞㗎！」
(keoi5 ngaan5 sap1 sap1 gam2 mong5 zyu6 ngo5, waa6: "m4 hou2 sik6 ngo5 aa3, ngo5 sik1 tiu3 mou5 gaa3!")
(It looked at me with teary eyes and said, "Don't eat me, I know how to dance!")

我忍唔住笑出聲，叫佢跳隻舞嚟睇下。
(ngo5 jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3 ceot1 seng1, giu3 keoi5 tiu3 zek3 mou5 lai4 tai2 haa5.)
(I couldn't help but laugh and asked it to dance for me to see.)

雞仔即刻跳咗一隻得意嘅雞仔舞，我見到覺得佢好得意，決定放佢走。
(gai1 zai2 zik1 hak1 tiu3 zo2 jat1 zek3 dak1 ji3 ge3 gai1 zai2 mou5, ngo5 gin3 dou3 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 dak1 ji3, kyut3 ding6 fong3 keoi5 zau2.)
(The chick immediately danced a cute chicken dance. I saw it and found it so adorable that I decided to let it go.)

最後，我食咗碗白飯，諗住下次再試下煮其他嘢食。
(zeoi3 hau6, ngo5 sik6 zo2 wun2 baak6 faan6, nam2 zyu6 haa6 ci3 zoi3 si3 haa5 zyu2 kei4 taa1 je5 sik6.)
(In the end, I ate a bowl of white rice, thinking I'd try cooking something else next time.)

宮保雞丁奇遇記

今日晏晝，我好想食宮保雞丁，諗起就流晒口水。
(gam1 jat6 aan3 zau3, ngo5 hou2 soeng2 sik6 gung1 bou2 gai1 ding1, nam2 hei2 zau6 lau4晒 hau2 seoi2.)
(Today for lunch, I really wanted to eat Kung Pao Chicken, just thinking about it made my mouth water.)

點知去到茶餐廳，老闆話賣晒，我即刻冇晒心機。
(dim2 zi1 heoi3 dou3 caa4 caan1 teng1, lou5 baan2 waa6 maai6晒, ngo5 zik1 hak1 mou5晒 sam1 gei1.)
(But when I got to the cha chaan teng, the owner said it was sold out, and I immediately lost all motivation.)

行行下，突然聞到一陣勁香嘅宮保雞丁味。
(haang4 haang4 haa5, dat6 jin4 man4 dou2 jat1陣 ging6 hoeng1 ge3 gung1 bou2 gai1 ding1 mei6.)
(While walking, I suddenly smelled a strong and delicious Kung Pao Chicken aroma.)

我跟住個味，發現原來係一隻識煮飯嘅雀仔整緊。
(ngo5 gan1 zyu6 go3 mei6, faat3 jin6 jyun4 lai4 hai6 jat1 zek3 sik1 zyu2 faan6 ge3 zoek3 zai2 zing2 gan2.)
(I followed the scent and discovered that it was actually a bird that knew how to cook, making it.)

佢見我咁鍾意食，就請我食咗一碗，真係好味到不得了！
(keoi5 gin3 ngo5 gam3 zung1 ji3 sik6, zau6 cing2 ngo5 sik6 zo2 jat1 wun2, zan1 hai6 hou2 mei6 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5!)
(Seeing how much I liked it, it invited me to eat a bowl, it was incredibly delicious!)

叉燒包嘅秘密

我細個嗰陣時，成日諗叉燒包入面嘅叉燒點樣入㗎？
(ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4, seng4 jat6 lam2 caa1 siu1 baau1 jap6 min6 ge3 caa1 siu1 dim2 joeng2 jap6 gaa3?)
(When I was little, I always wondered how the BBQ pork gets inside the BBQ pork bun?)

有日，我終於忍唔住問阿嫲。
(jau5 jat6, ngo5 zung1 jyu1 jan2 m4 zyu6 man6 aa3 maa4.)
(One day, I finally couldn't resist asking Grandma.)

阿嫲笑眯眯咁話：「係啲叉燒仔自己跳入去㗎！」
(aa3 maa4 siu3 mei1 mei1 gam2 waa6: "hai6 di1 caa1 siu1 zai2 zi6 gei2 tiu3 jap6 heoi3 gaa3!")
(Grandma smiled and said, "The little BBQ pork pieces jump in themselves!")

我信以為真，每次食叉燒包都忍唔住望吓啲叉燒，睇吓佢哋幾時跳。
(ngo5 seon3 ji5 wai4 zan1, mui5 ci3 sik6 caa1 siu1 baau1 dou1 jan2 m4 zyu6 mong5 haa5 di1 caa1 siu1, tai2 haa5 keoi5 dei6 gei2 si4 tiu3.)
(I believed her and every time I ate a BBQ pork bun, I couldn't help but watch the BBQ pork, to see when they would jump.)

大個咗先知阿嫲氹我，不過諗起都覺得好得意。
(daai6 go3 zo2 sin1 zi1 aa3 maa4 tam5 ngo5, bat1 gwo3 lam2 hei2 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 dak1 ji3.)
(I only found out when I grew up that Grandma was teasing me, but thinking about it still makes me smile.)

而家，我都會用呢個故仔氹我嘅仔女。
(ji4 gaa1, ngo5 dou1 wui2 jung6 ni1 go3 gu3 zai2 tam5 ngo5 ge3 zai2 neoi5.)
(Now, I use this story to amuse my own children.)

人球奇遇

阿婆喺公園踢人球，點知一唔小心踢咗上天。
(aa3 po4 hai2 gung1 jyun2 tek3 jan4 kau4, dim2 zhi1 jat1 m4 siu2 sam1 tek3 zo2 soeng5 tin1.)
(Grandma was kicking the human-shaped ball in the park, but she accidentally kicked it into the sky.)

人球飛呀飛，飛到月光上面，識咗個月亮婆婆。
(jan4 kau4 fei1 aa3 fei1, fei1 dou3 jyut6 gwong1 soeng6 min6, sik1 zo2 go3 jyut6 loeng6 po4 po4.)
(The human-shaped ball flew and flew, and flew to the moon, where it met a moon grandma.)

月亮婆婆請佢食咗好多星星糖，甜到漏。
(jyut6 loeng6 po4 po4 cheng2 keui5 sik6 zo2 hou2 do1 sing1 sing1 tong2, tim4 dou3 lau6.)
(The moon grandma invited it to eat lots of star candies, so sweet they were dripping.)

人球食飽飽，又坐住流星返番落地球。
(jan4 kau4 sik6 baau2 baau2, jau6 zo6 zyu6 lau4 sing1 faan1 faan1 lok6 dei6 kau4.)
(The human-shaped ball, with a full tummy, rode a shooting star back to Earth.)

阿婆見返人球，笑到見牙唔見眼。
(aa3 po4 gin3 faan1 jan4 kau4, siu3 dou3 gin3 ngaa4 m4 gin3 ngaan5.)
(Grandma, seeing the human-shaped ball again, smiled so wide you couldn't see her eyes.)

貓嘅一日

阿花瞓醒伸個懶腰，喵喵叫咗兩聲。
(aa3 faa1 fan3 sing2 san1 go3 laan5 jiu1, miu1 miu1 giu3 zo2 loeng5 seng1.)
(Ah Fa woke up, stretched, and meowed twice.)

佢跳落地下，搵主人婆婆餵佢食嘢。
(keoi5 tiu3 lok6 dei6 haa2, wan2 zyu2 jan4 po4 po2 wai3 keoi5 sik6 je5.)
(She jumped to the floor, looking for her owner, Granny, to feed her.)

食飽之後，阿花就喺窗邊曬太陽，舒服到眯埋眼。
(sik6 baau2 zi1 hau6, aa3 faa1 zau6 hai2 coeng1 bin1 saai3 tai3 joeng4, syu1 fuk6 dou3 mai1 maai4 ngaan5.)
(After eating her fill, Ah Fa sunbathed by the window, so comfortable she squinted.)

晏晝佢同隻老鼠玩捉迷藏，點知老鼠太叻走甩咗。
(aan3 zau3 keoi5 tung4 zek3 lou5 syu2 waan2 zuk1 mai4 cong4, dim2 zi1 lou5 syu2 taai3 lek1 zau2 syut1 zo2.)
(In the afternoon, she played hide-and-seek with a mouse, but the mouse was too clever and escaped.)

夜晚，阿花瞓喺主人婆婆嘅大髀上面，甜甜地發夢。
(je6 maan1, aa3 faa1 fan3 hai2 zyu2 jan4 po4 po2 ge3 daai6 bei2 soeng6 min6, tim4 tim4 dei2 faat3 mung6.)
(At night, Ah Fa slept on Granny's lap, having sweet dreams.)

湖中奇遇

阿婆喺湖邊釣魚，諗住煲個靚魚湯。
(aa3 po4 hai2 wu4 bin1 diu3 jyu2, nam2 zyu6 bou1 go3 leng3 jyu2 tong1.)
(Grandma was fishing by the lake, thinking of making a delicious fish soup.)

點知釣到唔係魚，而係一隻識講嘢嘅金龜。
(dim2 zi1 diu3 dou2 m4 hai6 jyu2, ji4 hai6 jat1 zek3 sik1 gong2 je5 ge3 gam1 gwai1.)
(Unexpectedly, she didn't catch a fish, but a golden turtle that could talk!)

金龜話佢係湖中嘅守護神，想報答阿婆嘅善良。
(gam1 gwai1 waa6 keoi5 hai6 wu4 zung1 ge3 sau2 wu6 san4, soeng2 bou3 daap3 aa3 po4 ge3 sin6 loeng4.)
(The golden turtle said it was the guardian of the lake and wanted to repay Grandma's kindness.)

阿婆笑笑口，話：「我淨係希望你哋喺湖裏面開開心心咁生活。」
(aa3 po4 siu3 siu3 hau2, waa6: "ngo5 zing6 hai6 hei1 mong6 nei5 dei6 hai2 wu4 leoi5 min6 hoi1 hoi1 sam1 sam1 gam2 sang1 wut6.")
(Grandma smiled and said, "I only hope you all live happily in the lake.")

金龜聽完好感動，送咗粒閃閃生輝嘅珍珠俾阿婆。
(gam1 gwai1 ting1 jyun4 hou2 gam2 dung6, sung3 zo2 lap1 sim2 sim2 sang1 fai1 ge3 zan1 zyu1 bei2 aa3 po4.)
(The golden turtle was very touched and gave Grandma a glittering pearl.)

阿婆攞住珍珠，覺得今日嘅陽光特別溫暖。
(aa3 po4 lo2 zyu6 zan1 zyu1, gok3 dak1 gam1 jat6 ge3 joeng4 gwong1 dak6 bit6 wan1 nyun5.)
(Grandma held the pearl, feeling that the sunlight today was especially warm.)

買電器奇遇

阿婆行入百老匯，諗住買部新電視。
(aa3 po4 haang4 jap6 baak3 lou5 wui2, nam2 zyu6 maai5 bou6 san1 din6 si6.)
(Grandma walked into Best Buy, thinking of buying a new TV.)

點知見到個機械人喺度跳緊舞，嚇咗一跳！
(dim2 zi1 gin3 dou2 go3 gei1 haai6 jan4 hai2 dou6 tiu3 gan2 mou5, haak3 zo2 jat1 tiu3!)
(Unexpectedly, she saw a robot dancing there, giving her quite a fright!)

個機械人仲話：「歡迎光臨！今日電視大減價！」
(go3 gei1 haai6 jan4 zung6 waa6: "fun1 jing4 gwong1 lam4! gam1 jat6 din6 si6 daai6 gaam2 gaa3!")
(The robot even said, "Welcome! Today there's a big TV sale!")

阿婆覺得得意，忍唔住笑咗出嚟。
(aa3 po4 gok3 dak1 dak1 ji3, jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3 zo2 chut1 lai4.)
(Grandma found it amusing and couldn't help but laugh.)

最後佢買咗部最大嘅電視，開心返屋企睇粵語長片。
(zeoi3 hau6 keoi5 maai5 zo2 bou6 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 din6 si6, hoi1 sam1 faan1 uk1 kei2 tai2 jyut6 jyu5 coeng4 pin3.)
(In the end, she bought the biggest TV and happily returned home to watch Cantonese movies.)

白石沙灘奇遇

有個細路仔喺白石沙灘執到一粒會發光嘅石頭。
(jau5 go3 sai3 lou6 zai2 hai2 baak6 sek6 saa1 taan1 zap1 dou2 jat1 lap1 wui5 faat3 gwong1 ge3 sek6 tau4.)
(A little boy picked up a glowing stone on White Rock Beach.)

佢覺得好得意，就放咗喺自己個水桶度。
(keoi5 gok3 dak1 hou2 dak1 ji3, zau6 fong3 zo2 hai2 zi6 gei2 go3 seoi2 tung2 dou6.)
(He found it very interesting, so he put it in his bucket.)

點知粒石頭一掂到啲海水，成個水桶即刻變咗做一架迷你潛水艇！
(dim2 zi1 lap1 sek6 tau4 jat1 dim6 dou3 di1 hoi2 seoi2, seng4 go3 seoi2 tung2 zik1 hak1 bin3 zo2 zou6 jat1 gaa3 mini cim4 seoi2 teng5!)
(Unexpectedly, as soon as the stone touched the seawater, the whole bucket instantly transformed into a mini submarine!)

細路仔嚇咗一跳，但又好興奮，就跳咗入去。
(sai3 lou6 zai2 haak3 zo2 jat1 tiu3, daan6 jau6 hou2 hing1 fan5, zau6 tiu3 zo2 jap6 heoi3.)
(The little boy was startled, but also very excited, so he jumped inside.)

架潛水艇載住佢，一路潛入深海，見到好多色彩繽紛嘅魚仔。
(gaa3 cim4 seoi2 teng5 zoi3 zyu6 keoi5, jat1 lou6 cim4 jap6 sam1 hoi2, gin3 dou2 hou2 do1 sik1 coi2 ban1 fan1 ge3 yu2 zai2.)
(The submarine carried him, diving all the way into the deep sea, where he saw many colorful little fish.)

佢玩得好開心，直到太陽開始落山，架潛水艇先變返個水桶。
(keoi5 waan2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1, zik6 dou3 taai3 joeng4 hoi1 ci2 lok6 saan1, gaa3 cim4 seoi2 teng5 sin1 bin3 faan1 go3 seoi2 tung2.)
(He had so much fun, until the sun began to set, and the submarine turned back into a bucket.)

返到屋企，細路仔將粒石頭小心翼翼咁收埋咗，期待下次嘅冒險。
(faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2, sai3 lou6 zai2 zoeng1 lap1 sek6 tau4 siu2 sam1 jik1 jik1 gam2 sau1 maai4 zo2, kei4 doi6 haa6 ci3 ge3 mou6 him2.)
(Back home, the little boy carefully hid the stone, looking forward to the next adventure.)

奇利域嘅冬甩冒險

阿婆鍾意喺奇利域嘅Tim Hortons飲咖啡。
(aa3 po4 zung1 ji3 hai2 kei4 lei6 wik6 ge3 Tim Hortons jam2 gaa3 fe1.)
(Grandma loves to drink coffee at the Chilliwack Tim Hortons.)

有日佢唔小心將個冬甩跌咗落地。
(jau5 jat6 geoi2 taai2 m4 siu2 sam1 zoeng1 go3 dung1 saat3 dit3 zo2 lok6 dei6.)
(One day, she accidentally dropped her donut on the floor.)

點知隻冬甩自己識得彈跳，仲彈咗出門口！
(dim2 zi1 zek3 dung1 saat3 zi6 gei2 sik1 dak1 taan4 tiu3, zung6 taan4 zo2 chut1 mun4 hau2!)
(Unexpectedly, the donut could bounce on its own, and it bounced out the door!)

阿婆即刻追出去，一路大叫：「嘩！隻冬甩走咗喇！」
(aa3 po4 zik1 hak1 zeoi1 chut1 heoi3, jat1 lou6 daai6 giu3: "waa1! zek3 dung1 saat3 zau2 zo2 laa3!")
(Grandma immediately chased after it, shouting all the way, "Wow! The donut ran away!")

隻冬甩最後彈到一個小朋友嘅手上，小朋友笑咪咪咁請阿婆食。
(zek3 dung1 saat3 zeoi3 hau6 taan4 dou3 jat1 go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 ge3 sau2 soeng6, siu2 pang4 jau5 siu3 mi1 mi1 gam2 ceng2 aa3 po4 sik6.)
(The donut finally bounced into the hands of a little kid, who smiled and offered it to Grandma.)

行山奇遇記

阿婆鍾意喺UBC後山行山，貪佢空氣好又夠靜。
(aa3 po4 zung1 ji3 hai2 jyu1 bi1 si1 hau6 saan1 haang4 saan1, taam1 keoi5 hung1 hei3 hou2 jau6 gau3 zing6.)
(Grandma loves hiking on the mountain behind UBC, appreciating the good air and quietness.)

有一日，佢見到一隻識講嘢嘅松鼠仔。
(jau5 jat1 jat6, keoi5 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 sik1 gong2 je5 ge3 sung1 syu2 zai2.)
(One day, she saw a talking squirrel.)

松鼠仔話佢想搵返佢唔見咗嘅金莎朱古力。
(sung1 syu2 zai2 waa6 keoi5 soeng2 wan2 faan1 keoi5 m4 gin3 zo2 ge3 gam1 saa1 zyu1 gu1 lik1.)
(The squirrel said he wanted to find his lost Ferrero Rocher chocolate.)

阿婆覺得好得意，就幫佢一齊搵。
(aa3 po4 gok3 dak1 hou2 dak1 ji3, zau6 bong1 keoi5 jat1 cai4 wan2.)
(Grandma found it very amusing, so she helped him look.)

最後，佢哋喺一棵大樹下面搵到粒朱古力，松鼠仔開心到跳舞！
(zeoi3 hau6, keoi5 dei6 hai2 jat1 fo1 daai6 syu6 haa6 min6 wan2 dou2 lap1 zyu1 gu1 lik1, sung1 syu2 zai2 hoi1 sam1 dou3 tiu3 mou5!)
(Finally, they found the chocolate under a big tree, and the squirrel was so happy it danced!)

開飯喇！

阿婆煮咗好多餸，香噴噴嘅。
(aa3 po4 zyu2 zo2 hou2 do1 sung3, hoeng1 pan3 pan1 ge3.)
(Grandma cooked a lot of dishes, they smell delicious.)

我哋一家人圍埋一齊食飯，好熱鬧。
(ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 wai4 maai4 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6, hou2 jit6 naau6.)
(Our whole family gathered together to eat, it's very lively.)

細佬夾咗嚿魚，點知骨都冇。
(sai3 lou2 gaap3 zo2 gau6 jyu2, dim2 zi1 gwat1 dou1 mou5.)
(Little brother picked up a piece of fish, but surprisingly, it had no bones.)

佢開心到彈起，話阿婆識魔法。
(keoi5 hoi1 sam1 dou3 daan6 hei2, waa6 aa3 po4 sik1 mo1 faat3.)
(He was so happy he jumped up, saying Grandma knows magic.)

阿婆笑瞇瞇咁話：「傻仔，係阿婆揀嘅魚好啫！」
(aa3 po4 siu3 mei1 mei1 gam2 waa6: "so4 zai2, hai6 aa3 po4 gaan2 ge3 jyu2 hou2 ze1!")
(Grandma smiled and said, "Silly boy, it's just that Grandma chose a good fish!")

貓貓嘅一日

阿喵瞓醒，伸個懶腰，「喵～」咗一聲。
(aa3 miu1 fan3 sing2, san1 go3 laan5 jiu1, "miu1~" zo2 jat1 seng1.)
(Ah Meow woke up, stretched lazily, and meowed once.)

佢跳落地下，行去飯兜度，發現冇嘢食，嬲嬲豬咁望住主人。
(keoi5 tiu3 lok6 dei6 haa2, haang4 heoi3 faan6 dau1 dou6, faat3 jin6 mou5 je5 sik6, nau1 nau1 zyu1 gam2 mong6 zyu6 zyu2 jan4.)
(He jumped down to the floor, went to his food bowl, found nothing to eat, and glared angrily at his owner.)

主人即刻醒晒，加咗好多魚仔俾佢。
(zyu2 jan4 zik1 hak1 sing2晒, gaa1 zo2 hou2 do1 jyu2 zai2 bei2 keoi5.)
(The owner immediately woke up completely and added a lot of fish to his bowl.)

食飽飽之後，阿喵就跳上窗台曬太陽，舒服到眯埋眼。
(sik6 baau2 baau2 zi1 hau6, aa3 miu1 zau6 tiu3 soeng5 cung1 toi4 saai3 tai3 joeng4, syu1 fuk6 dou3 mei1 maai4 ngaan5.)
(After eating his fill, Ah Meow jumped onto the windowsill to sunbathe, feeling so comfortable that he closed his eyes.)

突然，佢見到窗外面有隻雀仔，即刻精神晒，準備捉佢！
(dat6 jin4, keoi5 gin3 dou2 cung1 ngoi6 min6 jau5 zek3 zoek3 zai2, zik1 hak1 zing1 san4 saai3, zeon2 bei6 zuk1 keoi5!)
(Suddenly, he saw a bird outside the window, immediately perked up, and prepared to catch it!)

今晚食乜餸？

今日阿婆煮咗好多餸，香噴噴嘅！
(gam1 jat6 aa3 po4 zyu2 zo2 hou2 do1 sung3, hoeng1 pan3 pan3 ge3!)
(Grandma cooked a lot of dishes today, they smell amazing!)

首先，有一碟豉油皇炒麵，好彈牙呀！
(sau2 sin1, jau5 jat1 dip6 si6 jau4 wong4 caau2 min6, hou2 daan6 ngaa4 aa3!)
(First, there's a plate of soy sauce fried noodles, so chewy!)

跟住，仲有蒸魚，新鮮到不得了！
(gan1 zeoi6, zung6 jau5 zing1 jyu2, san1 sin1 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5!)
(Then, there's also steamed fish, incredibly fresh!)

最後，阿婆秘密武器係佢嘅老火湯，飲咗暖笠笠。
(zeoi3 hau6, aa3 po4 bei3 mat6 bou2 hei3 hai6 keoi5 ge3 lou5 fo2 tong1, jam2 zo2 nuon5 lap1 lap1.)
(Finally, Grandma's secret weapon is her slow-cooked soup, drinking it makes you feel warm and cozy.)

食完飯，我哋一家人圍埋一齊傾偈，真係好開心。
(sik6 jyun4 faan6, ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 wai4 maai4 jat1 cai4 king1 gai2, zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1.)
(After dinner, our family gathered together to chat, it was really happy.)

今晚嘅秘密晚餐

今晚我哋一家人食飯，阿嫲煮咗好多嘢食。
(gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 sik6 faan6, aa3 maa4 zyu2 zo2 hou2 do1 je5 sik6.)
(Tonight, our family is having dinner, and Grandma cooked a lot of food.)

枱上面有咕嚕肉、蒸魚，仲有我最鍾意嘅番茄炒蛋！
(toi2 soeng6 min6 jau5 gu1 lou1 juk6, zing1 jyu2, zung6 jau5 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 faan1 ke2 caau2 daan2!)

游水奇遇

神秘嘅消失雪糕車

架雪糕車突然唔見咗，搞到成條街嘅細路都好失望。

月亮嘅士

阿婆搭咗架月亮嘅士，準備返去雲上面嘅屋企。

司機係一隻識唱歌嘅白兔仔，一路車一路唱歌。

月光下的貓

點知我喺貓貓瞓覺嘅床下底搵到個菠蘿包，但係俾佢咬咗一啖。

我笑咗出嚟，心諗：「算啦，一人一半啦！」
