賣魚蛋嘅秘密

阿婆日日喺街口賣魚蛋，啲魚蛋香到成條街都聞到。
(aa3 po4 jat1 jat1 hai2 gaai1 hau2 maai6 jyu2 daan2, di1 jyu2 daan2 hoeng1 dou3 seng4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 man4 dou2.)
(Grandma sells fish balls at the street corner every day, and the aroma of the fish balls is so strong that the whole street can smell it.)

有個細路哥問佢：「阿婆，點解你嘅魚蛋咁好食㗎？」
(jau5 go3 sai3 lou6 go1 man6 keoi5: "aa3 po4, dim2 gaai2 nei5 ge3 jyu2 daan2 gam3 hou2 sik6 gaa3?")
(A child asked her, "Grandma, why are your fish balls so delicious?")

阿婆笑瞇瞇咁話：「秘密就喺呢個裝魚蛋嘅煲底呀！」
(aa3 po4 siu3 mei1 mei1 gam2 waa6: "bei3 mat6 zau6 hai2 ni1 go3 zong1 jyu2 daan2 ge3 bou1 dai2 aa3!")
(Grandma said with a smile, "The secret is at the bottom of this pot where I keep the fish balls!")

原來煲底黐住舊舊嘅陳皮，令到啲魚蛋帶有獨特嘅香味。
(jyun4 lai4 bou1 dai2 ci1 zyu6 gau6 gau6 ge3 can2 pei4, ling6 dou3 di1 jyu2 daan2 daai3 jau5 duk6 dak6 ge3 hoeng1 mei6.)
(It turned out that the bottom of the pot was stuck with old dried tangerine peels, giving the fish balls a unique fragrance.)

細路哥忍唔住買咗串魚蛋，一啖咬落去，嘩，真係好食到飛起！
(sai3 lou6 go1 jan2 m4 zyu6 maai5 zo2 cyun3 jyu2 daan2, jat1 daam6 ngaau5 lok6 heoi3, waa3, zan1 hai6 hou2 sik6 dou3 fei1 hei2!)
(The child couldn't resist buying a skewer of fish balls, and took a bite, wow, they were so delicious they made you fly!)

行山遇見熊仔

阿婆行緊山，一路唱住粵曲，心情靚靚。
(aa3 po4 haang4 gan2 saan1, jat1 lou6 coeng3 zyu6 jyut6 kuk1, sam1 cing4 leng3 leng3.)
(Grandma was hiking in the mountains, singing Cantonese opera along the way, in a very good mood.)

突然，佢見到一隻細細隻嘅熊仔，喺度食緊啲樹莓。
(dat6 jin4, keoi5 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 sai3 sai3 zek3 ge3 hung4 zai2, hai2 dou6 sik6 gan2 di1 syu6 mui2.)
(Suddenly, she saw a small bear cub, eating some raspberries.)

阿婆唔驚，仲同熊仔講：「嘩，你都幾識歎喎！」
(aa3 po4 m4 geng1, zung2 tung4 hung4 zai2 gong2: "waa1, nei5 dou1 gei2 sik1 taan3 wo3!")
(Grandma wasn't scared, and even said to the bear cub, "Wow, you really know how to enjoy life!")

熊仔好似聽得明，仲伸脷仔笑咗笑。
(hung4 zai2 hou2 ci5 ting1 dak1 ming4, zung2 san1 lei6 zai2 siu3 zo2 siu3.)
(The bear cub seemed to understand, and even stuck out its little tongue and smiled.)

阿婆醒起自己帶咗個菠蘿包，就分咗一半俾佢。
(aa3 po4 sing2 hei2 zi6 gei2 daai3 zo2 go3 bo1 lo4 baau1, zau6 fan1 zo2 jat1 bun3 bei2 keoi5.)
(Grandma remembered she brought a pineapple bun, so she shared half of it with him.)

一人一熊，就喺山上面開開心心咁食下午茶。
(jat1 jan4 jat1 hung4, zau6 hai2 saan1 soeng6 min6 hoi1 hoi1 sam1 sam1 gam2 sik6 haa6 ng5 caa4.)
(One person and one bear, happily ate afternoon tea on the mountain.)

迷路嘅小熊

阿婆行山嗰陣，見到一隻細細粒嘅熊仔喺樹林入面迷路。
(aa3 po4 haang4 saan1 go2 zan6, gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 sai3 sai3 lap1 ge3 hung4 zai2 hai2 syu6 lam4 jap6 min6 mai4 lou6.)
(When Grandma was hiking, she saw a tiny bear cub lost in the forest.)

熊仔眼濕濕，好似想搵媽媽咁。
(hung4 zai2 ngaan5 sap1 sap1, hou2 ci5 soeng2 wan2 maa4 maa1 gam2.)
(The bear cub's eyes were watery, as if it wanted to find its mama.)

阿婆諗起自己個孫，即刻覺得好心痛。
(aa3 po4 lam2 hei2 zi6 gei2 go3 syun1, zik1 hak1 gok3 dak1 hou2 sam1 tung3.)
(Grandma thought of her own grandson, and immediately felt a pang of sympathy.)

佢拎咗啲麵包出嚟，輕聲細語咁問熊仔：「肚唔肚餓呀？」
(keoi5 ling1 zo2 di1 min6 baau1 chut1 lai4, hing1 seng1 sai3 jyu5 gam2 man6 hung4 zai2: "tou5 m4 tou5 ngo6 aa3?")
(She took out some bread and gently asked the bear cub, "Are you hungry?")

熊仔聞到麵包香，即刻唔喊，仲伸脷仔舔舔脷。
(hung4 zai2 man4 dou2 min6 baau1 hoeng1, zik1 hak1 m4 haam3, zung1 san1 lei5 zai2 tim2 tim2 lei5.)
(The bear cub smelled the bread, immediately stopped crying, and even stuck out its little tongue to lick its lips.)

阿婆帶住熊仔，沿住山路慢慢行，終於聽到遠處有熊媽媽嘅叫聲。
(aa3 po4 daai3 zyu6 hung4 zai2, jyun4 zyu6 saan1 lou6 maan6 maan2 haang4, zung1 jyu1 ting1 dou2 jyun5 cyu3 jau5 hung4 maa4 maa1 ge3 giu3 seng1.)
(Grandma led the bear cub, slowly walking along the mountain path, and finally heard a bear mama's call in the distance.)

熊媽媽見到熊仔，即刻衝過嚟，多謝咗阿婆幾聲，然後拖住熊仔返屋企喇。
(hung4 maa4 maa1 gin3 dou2 hung4 zai2, zik1 hak1 cung1 gwo3 lai4, do1 ze6 zo2 aa3 po4 gei2 seng1, jin4 hau6 to1 zyu6 hung4 zai2 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa3.)
(The bear mama saw the bear cub, immediately rushed over, thanked Grandma a few times, and then dragged the bear cub home.)

糖果雨

細路阿寶朝早醒嚟，見到天上落緊糖果雨。
(sai3 lou6 aa3 bou2 ziu1 zou2 seng2 lai4, gin3 dou3 tin1 soeng6 lok6 gan2 tong4 gwo2 jyu5.)
(Little Ah Bo woke up in the morning and saw candy raining from the sky.)

佢開心到戴住雨傘去接糖果，結果傘都裝唔晒，糖果滾到成廳都係。
(keoi5 hoi1 sam1 dou3 daai3 zyu6 jyu5 saan3 heoi3 zip3 tong4 gwo2, git3 gwo2 saan3 dou1 zong1 m4 saai3, tong4 gwo2 gwan2 dou3 seng4 teng1 dou1 hai6.)
(He happily took an umbrella to catch candy, but it couldn’t hold them all; the candies rolled all over the living room.)

隔離鄰居見到，都跑嚟搶糖果，好似過聖誕咁。
(gak3 lei4 leon4 geoi1 gin3 dou3, dou1 paau2 lai4 coeng2 tong4 gwo2, hou2 ci5 gwo3 sing3 daan3 gam2.)
(The neighbors saw and ran to grab candy, like it was Christmas.)

最後，阿寶笑住講：下次要帶籃子，唔好用雨傘！
(zeoi3 hau6, aa3 bou2 siu3 zyu6 gong2: haa6 ci3 jiu3 daai3 laam4 zi2, m4 hou2 jung6 jyu5 saan3!)
(In the end, Ah Bo laughed and said: Next time I’ll bring a basket, not an umbrella!)

傾偈劉德華

今日喺茶餐廳撞到劉德華，真係估佢唔到！
(Gam1 jat6 hai2 caa4 caan1 teng1 zong6 dou2 Lau4 Dak1 Wah4, zan1 hai6 gu2 keoi5 m4 dou2!)
(Today, I bumped into Andy Lau at a Cha Chaan Teng, I really couldn't believe it!)

我鼓起勇氣上前問佢可唔可以影張相。
(Ngo5 gu2 hei2 yung5 hei3 soeng5 cin4 man6 keoi5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ying2 zoeng1 seung2.)
(I mustered up the courage to go up and ask him if I could take a photo.)

佢好nice咁應承咗，仲同我講咗聲「恭喜發財」！
(Keoi5 hou2 nice gam2 ying3 sing4 zo2, zung1 tung4 ngo5 gong2 zo2 seng1 "Gung1 hei2 faat3 coi4"!)
(He very nicely agreed, and even said "Gong Hei Fat Choy" to me!)

我開心到成晚瞓唔着，覺得自己好幸運。
(Ngo5 hoi1 sam1 dou3 seng4 maan5 fan3 m4 zoek3, gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hou2 hang6 wan6.)
(I was so happy I couldn't sleep all night, I felt so lucky.)

之後我決定買多幾張佢嘅演唱會飛，支持佢！
(Zi1 hau6 ngo5 kyut3 ding6 maai5 do1 gei2 zoeng1 keoi5 ge3 jin2 coeng3 wui2 fei1, zi1 ci4 keoi5!)
(After that, I decided to buy a few more tickets to his concert to support him!)

摘藍莓奇遇

阿婆帶住小明去摘藍莓，諗住整藍莓批。
(aa3 po4 daai3 zoek3 siu2 ming4 heoi3 zaak6 laam4 mui2, nam2 zoek3 zing2 laam4 mui2 pai1.)
(Grandma took Little Ming to pick blueberries, planning to make a blueberry pie.)

點知行到一半，見到一隻識講嘢嘅藍莓精靈。
(dim2 zi1 haang4 dou3 jat1 bun3, gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 sik1 gong2 je5 ge3 laam4 mui2 zing1 ling4.)
(Unexpectedly, halfway there, they saw a blueberry spirit that could talk.)

佢話：「唔好摘晒啲藍莓呀，留返啲俾我哋食！」
(keoi5 waa6: "m4 hou2 zaak6 saai3 di1 laam4 mui2 aa3, lau4 faan1 di1 bei2 ngo5 dei6 sik6!")
(It said, "Don't pick all the blueberries, leave some for us to eat!")

阿婆同小明覺得好得意，應承咗。
(aa3 po4 tung4 siu2 ming4 gok3 dak1 hou2 dak1 ji3, jing3 sing4 zo2.)
(Grandma and Little Ming found it very interesting and agreed.)

佢哋摘咗一籃藍莓，留咗好多俾精靈，開開心心返屋企。
(keoi5 dei6 zaak6 zo2 jat1 laam4 laam4 mui2, lau4 zo2 hou2 do1 bei2 zing1 ling4, hoi1 hoi1 sam1 sam1 faan1 uk1 kei2.)
(They picked a basket of blueberries, left a lot for the spirit, and happily went home.)

返到屋企，阿婆整咗個特別好味嘅藍莓批，小明話係因為精靈保佑。
(faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2, aa3 po4 zing2 zo2 go3 dak6 bit6 hou2 mei6 ge3 laam4 mui2 pai1, siu2 ming4 waa6 hai6 jan1 wai6 zing1 ling4 bou2 jau6.)
(Back home, Grandma made a particularly delicious blueberry pie, and Little Ming said it was because the spirit blessed it.)

舊戲新樂

阿婆喺廳度睇緊八十年代嘅電影，笑到見牙唔見眼。
(aa3 po4 hai2 teng1 dou6 tai2 gan2 baat3 sap6 nin4 doi6 ge3 din6 ying2, siu3 dou3 gin3 ngaa4 m4 gin3 ngaan5.)
(Grandma was watching an 80s movie in the living room, laughing so hard you couldn't see her eyes.)

啲髮型同衫真係好攪笑，佢話以前後生嗰陣都係咁樣㗎。
(di1 faat3 ying4 tung4 saam1 zan1 hai2 hou2 gaau2 siu3, keoi5 waa6 ji5 cin4 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 dou1 hai6 gam2 joeng2 gaa3.)
(The hairstyles and clothes are so funny, she said she used to be like that when she was young.)

突然，電視嘅畫面閃咗一下，出現咗一個後生嘅阿婆。
(dat6 jin4, din6 si6 ge3 waa2 min6 sim2 zo2 jat1 haa5, cheut1 hin1 zo2 jat1 go3 hau6 saang1 ge3 aa3 po4.)
(Suddenly, the TV screen flickered, and a younger version of Grandma appeared.)

後生阿婆喺電視入面同而家嘅阿婆揮手，仲講咗句：「喂，老友記！」
(hau6 saang1 aa3 po4 hai2 din6 si6 yap6 min6 tung4 ji4 gaa1 ge3 aa3 po4 fai1 sau2, zung6 gong2 zo2 geoi3: "wai2, lou5 jau5 gei3!")
(The younger Grandma waved to the current Grandma from inside the TV and even said, "Hey, old friend!")

阿婆嚇咗一跳，但係跟住又忍唔住笑出聲。
(aa3 po4 haak3 zo2 jat1 tiu3, daan6 hai6 gan1 zeoi3 jau6 yan2 m4 zyu6 siu3 cheut1 seng1.)
(Grandma was startled, but then she couldn't help but laugh out loud.)

阿婆嘅Tim Hortons 奇遇

阿婆行入 Tim Hortons，諗住嘆杯熱咖啡。
(aa3 po4 haang4 jap6 Tim Hortons, lam2 zyu6 taan3 bui1 jit6 gaa3 fe1.)
(Grandma walked into Tim Hortons, thinking of enjoying a cup of hot coffee.)

點知佢竟然見到隻識講嘢嘅貓咪喺度排隊！
(dim2 zi1 keoi5 ging2 jin4 gin3 dou2 zek3 sik1 gong2 je5 ge3 maau1 mi1 hai2 dou6 paai4 deoi2!)
(Unexpectedly, she saw a talking cat queuing up!)

貓咪話：「唔該，一杯double-double，少甜！」
(maau1 mi1 waa6: "m4 goi1, jat1 bui1 double-double, siu2 tim4!")
(The cat said, "Excuse me, one double-double, less sweet!")

阿婆嚇到差啲跌咗個假牙，但係又覺得好得意。
(aa3 po4 haak3 dou3 caa1 di1 dit3 zo2 go3 gaa2 ngaa4, daan6 hai6 jau6 gok3 dak1 hou2 dak1 ji3.)
(Grandma was so startled she almost dropped her dentures, but she also found it very cute.)

佢忍唔住買多咗個 donut 請隻貓咪食。
(keoi5 jan2 m4 zyu6 maai5 do1 zo2 go3 donut ceng2 zek3 maau1 mi1 sik6.)
(She couldn't resist buying an extra donut to treat the cat.)

貓咪食完，仲同阿婆講咗聲「多謝晒！」
(maau1 mi1 sik6 jyun4, zung1 tung4 aa3 po4 gong2 zo2 seng1 "do1 ze6 saai3!")
(After eating, the cat even said "Thank you very much!" to Grandma.)

阿婆笑到見牙唔見眼，覺得今日嘅咖啡特別好飲。
(aa3 po4 siu3 dou3 gin3 ngaa4 m4 gin3 ngaan5, gok3 dak1 gam1 jat6 ge3 gaa3 fe1 dak6 bit1 hou2 jam2.)
(Grandma smiled so wide you couldn't see her eyes, and felt today's coffee tasted extra delicious.)

飲啖Tim仔，諗計仔

阿婆鍾意朝朝飲啖Tim仔，精神爽利諗計仔。
(aa3 po4 zung1 ji3 ziu1 ziu1 jam2 daam6 Tim1 zai2, zing1 san4 song2 lei6 nam2 gai3 zai2.)
(Grandma likes to have a sip of Tim Hortons every morning, feeling energetic and thinking of ideas.)

佢今日諗到用咖啡渣嚟種花，慳錢又環保。
(keoi5 gam1 jat6 nam2 dou2 yung6 gaa3 fe1 zaa1 lai4 zung2 faa1, haan1 cin2 jau6 waan4 bou2.)
(Today, she thought of using coffee grounds to plant flowers, saving money and being environmentally friendly.)

啲花開得好靚，引嚟好多雀仔唱歌。
(di1 faa1 hoi1 dak1 hou2 leng3, yan5 lai4 hou2 do1 zoek3 zai2 cheung3 go1.)
(The flowers bloomed beautifully, attracting many birds to sing.)

阿婆笑瞇瞇，覺得飲咖啡唔止醒神，仲可以變靚花園。
(aa3 po4 siu3 mei1 mei1, gok3 dak1 jam2 gaa3 fe1 m4 zi2 sing2 san4, zung6 ho2 ji5 bin3 leng3 faa1 yun4.)
(Grandma smiled, feeling that drinking coffee not only wakes her up, but also beautifies her garden.)

佢嘅鄰居見到，都話要學佢咁做，一齊環保愛地球。
(keoi5 ge3 leon4 geoi1 gin3 dou2, dou1 waa6 jiu3 hok6 keoi5 gam2 zou6, yat1 chai4 waan4 bou2 oi3 dei6 kau4.)
(Her neighbors saw it and said they wanted to learn from her, to be environmentally friendly and love the Earth together.)

學嘢喺Tim記

我今日喺Tim記學廣東話，隔離枱阿婆教我講「唔該晒」。
(ngo5 gam1 jat6 hai2 Tim1 gei2 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2, gaak3 lei4 toi2 aa3 po4 gaau3 ngo5 gong2 "m4 goi1 saai3".)
(Today at Tim Hortons, I learned Cantonese, the grandma at the next table taught me to say "thank you very much".)

點知我講到「唔該屎」，阿婆笑到見牙唔見眼。
(dim2 ji1 ngo5 gong2 dou3 "m4 goi1 si2", aa3 po4 siu3 dou3 gin3 ngaa4 m4 gin3 ngaan5.)
(But I said "thank you poop", the grandma laughed so hard she crinkled her eyes.)

佢話：「屎唔食得㗎，你都傻傻哋！」
(keoi5 waa6: "si2 m4 sik6 dak1 gaa3, nei5 dou1 so4 so4 dei2!".)
(She said: "You can't eat poop, you're a little silly!")

我哋兩個笑到咖啡都噴埋出嚟，真係瘀皮。
(ngo5 dei6 leong5 go3 siu3 dou3 gaa3 fe1 dou1 pun3 maai4 chut1 lai4, zan1 hai6 jyu1 pei4.)
(We both laughed so hard that coffee sprayed out, it was really embarrassing.)

不過，學廣東話最緊要係開心嘛，瘀皮都抵啦！
(bat1 gwo3, hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 hoi1 sam1 maa3, jyu1 pei4 dou1 dai2 laa1!)
(But, the most important thing about learning Cantonese is to be happy, so even embarrassment is worth it!)

學廣東話喺 Tim Hortons

我阿婆鍾意喺 Tim Hortons 飲咖啡學廣東話。
(ngo5 aa3 po4 zung1 ji3 hai2 Tim Hortons jam2 gaa3 fe1 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2.)
(My grandma loves to drink coffee and learn Cantonese at Tim Hortons.)

佢話啲咖啡夠提神，啲同學又夠親切。
(keoi5 waa6 di1 gaa3 fe1 gau3 tai4 san4, di1 tung4 hok6 jau6 gau3 can1 cit3.)
(She says the coffee is energizing enough, and the classmates are friendly enough.)

有日，佢學識咗一句「唔該，少甜」，仲用嚟同個店員講。
(jau5 jat6, keoi5 hok6 sik1 zo2 jat1 geoi3 "m4 goi1, siu2 tim4", zung6 jung6 lai4 tung4 go3 dim3 jyun4 gong2.)
(One day, she learned the phrase "excuse me, less sugar" and used it to say to the clerk.)

個店員聽到，笑住話：「婆婆，你講得好正啊！」
(go3 dim3 jyun4 ting1 dou2, siu3 zyu6 waa6: "po4 po2, nei5 gong2 dak1 hou2 zeng3 aa3!")
(The clerk heard it, smiled and said, "Grandma, you speak really well!")

阿婆開心到即刻請佢飲多杯咖啡。
(aa3 po4 hoi1 sam1 dou3 zik1 hak1 ceng2 keoi5 jam2 do1 bui1 gaa3 fe1.)
(Grandma was so happy that she immediately offered to buy him another cup of coffee.)

雀仔嘅秘密花園

阿婆喺公園種咗好多靚花。
(aa3 po4 hai2 gung1 yun2 zung3 zo2 ho2 do1 leng3 faa1.)
(Grandma planted many beautiful flowers in the park.)

一日，佢發現花上面多咗好多窿。
(jat1 jat6, keoi5 faat3 jin6 faa1 soeng6 min6 do1 zo2 ho2 do1 lung1.)
(One day, she discovered many holes on the flowers.)

阿婆好嬲，諗住捉鬼。
(aa3 po4 hou2 nau1, nam2 zyu6 zuk1 gwai2.)
(Grandma was very angry and thought of catching the culprit.)

點知，佢見到一班雀仔喺度開緊 party！
(dim2 zi1, keoi5 gin3 dou2 jat1 baan1 zoek3 zai2 hai2 dou6 hoi1 gan2 party!)
(Unexpectedly, she saw a group of birds having a party!)

佢哋用啲花蜜當汽水飲，仲跳晒舞咁開心。
(keoi5 dei6 jung6 di1 faa1 mat6 dong3 hei3 seoi2 jam2, zung6 tiu3 saai3 mou5 gam2 hoi1 sam1.)
(They were using the flower nectar as soda and were dancing happily.)

阿婆見到佢哋咁得意，都忍唔住笑咗出嚟。
(aa3 po4 gin3 dou2 keoi5 dei6 gam3 dak1 ji3, dou1 jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3 zo2 chut1 lai4.)
(Grandma found them so adorable that she couldn't help but laugh.)

從此，阿婆就偷偷地留多啲花畀雀仔開 party 啦。
(cung4 ci2, aa3 po4 zau6 tau1 tau1 dei6 lau4 do1 di1 faa1 bei2 zoek3 zai2 hoi1 party laa1.)
(From then on, Grandma secretly left more flowers for the birds to have their parties.)

storyName: 麥當勞叔叔嘅秘密基地
storyBody:
麥當勞叔叔嘅秘密基地

阿明有個麥當勞叔叔玩具，細細粒好得意。
(aa3 ming4 jau5 go3 mak6 dong1 lou4 suk1 suk1 wan2 geoi6, sai3 sai3 lap1 hou2 dak1 ji3.)
(Ah Ming has a McDonald's Uncle toy, small and very cute.)

有一晚，佢瞓覺嗰陣，聽到櫃桶入面有聲。
(jau5 jat1 maan5, keoi5 fan3 gaau3 go2 zan6, teng1 dou2 gwai6 tong2 jap6 min6 jau5 seng1.)
(One night, when he was sleeping, he heard a noise from inside the drawer.)

原來係麥當勞叔叔帶埋啲迷你漢堡包開派對！
(jyun4 lai4 hai6 mak6 dong1 lou4 suk1 suk1 daai3 maai4 di1 mai4 nei5 hon3 bou2 baau1 hoi1 paai3 deoi2!)
(It turned out to be McDonald's Uncle bringing mini hamburgers to have a party!)

佢哋靜雞雞咁跳舞唱歌，好開心㗎。
(keoi5 dei6 zing6 gai1 gai1 gam2 tiu3 mou5 cheung3 go1, hou2 hoi1 sam1 gaa3.)
(They were quietly dancing and singing, very happy.)

第二日，阿明見到櫃桶入面有啲麵包糠，就知係真㗎喇！
(dai6 ji6 jat6, aa3 ming4 gin3 dou2 gwai6 tong2 jap6 min6 jau5 di1 min6 baau1 hong1, zau6 zi1 hai6 zan1 gaa3 laa1!)
(The next day, Ah Ming saw some breadcrumbs in the drawer and knew it was real!)

麥當勞叔叔嘅新朋友

麥當勞叔叔今日喺公園遇到一個好得意嘅迷你版自己。
(mak6 dong1 lou4 suk1 suk1 gam1 jat6 hai2 gung1 jyun2 jyu6 dou2 jat1 go3 hou2 dak1 ji3 ge3 mai4 nei5 baan2 zi6 gei2.)
(Uncle McDonald met a very cute mini version of himself in the park today.)

佢著住同叔叔一樣嘅黃色衫同紅色鞋，細細粒，好得意。
(keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 tung4 suk1 suk1 jat1 joeng6 ge3 wong4 sik1 saam1 tung4 hung4 sik1 haai4, sai3 sai3 lap1, hou2 dak1 ji3.)
(He was wearing the same yellow clothes and red shoes as Uncle, small and very cute.)

原來佢係一個迷路嘅麥當勞玩具，唔記得咗返屋企嘅路。
(jyun4 loi4 keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 mai4 lou6 ge3 mak6 dong1 lou4 wun6 geoi6, m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 faan1 uk1 kei2 ge3 lou6.)
(Turns out he was a lost McDonald's toy, and forgot the way back home.)

麥當勞叔叔笑住攬住佢，話會帶佢返去開心樂園餐。
(mak6 dong1 lou4 suk1 suk1 siu3 zyu6 laam5 zyu6 keoi5, waa6 wui5 daai3 keoi5 faan1 heoi3 hoi1 sam1 lok6 jyun4 caan1.)
(Uncle McDonald hugged him with a smile, and said he would take him back to the Happy Meal.)

個迷你叔叔開心到跳起，因為佢終於搵到屋企啦！
(go3 mai4 nei5 suk1 suk1 hoi1 sam1 dou3 tiu3 hei2, jan1 wai6 keoi5 zung1 jyu1 wan2 dou2 uk1 kei2 laa1!)
(The mini Uncle jumped for joy, because he had finally found his home!)

你去邊呀？

阿婆今日攞住個大紅袋，笑眯眯咁問我。
(aa3 po4 gam1 jat6 lo2 zyu6 go3 daai6 hung4 doi2, siu3 mi1 mi1 gam2 man6 ngo5.)
(Grandma, holding a big red bag today, asked me with a smile.)

我話：「我去街市買餸煮飯呀！」
(ngo5 waa6: "ngo5 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 sung3 zyu2 faan6 aa3!")
(I said, "I'm going to the market to buy groceries to cook!")

阿婆拍拍個紅袋，神神秘秘咁講：「我呀，就去搵隻識唱歌嘅金魚！」
(aa3 po4 paak3 paak3 go3 hung4 doi2, san4 san4 bei3 bei3 gam2 gong2: "ngo5 aa3, zau6 heoi3 wan2 zek3 sik1 coeng3 go1 ge3 gam1 yu2!")
(Grandma patted the red bag and said mysteriously, "As for me, I'm going to find a goldfish that can sing!")

我呆咗，忍唔住笑出聲，覺得阿婆真係好得意。
(ngo5 ngoi4 zo2, jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3 chut1 seng1, gok3 dak1 aa3 po4 zan1 hai6 hou2 dak1 ji3.)
(I was stunned and couldn't help but laugh, thinking Grandma was really cute.)

原來阿婆想買隻特別嘅金魚，氹吓自己開心。
(jyun4 loi4 aa3 po4 soeng2 maai5 zek3 dak6 bit3 ge3 gam1 yu2, tum2 haa5 zi6 gei2 hoi1 sam1.)
(Turns out Grandma wanted to buy a special goldfish to cheer herself up.)

你去邊啊？

阿婆今日要去街市買餸，準備整返餐好嘅俾啲孫仔食。
(aa3 po4 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 sung3, zeon2 bei6 zing2 faan1 caan1 hou2 ge3 bei2 di1 syun1 zai2 sik6.)
(Grandma is going to the market today to buy groceries, preparing to cook a nice meal for her grandchildren.)

佢諗住買啲新鮮嘅魚同菜，等啲小朋友食得健康啲。
(keoi5 lam2 zyu6 maai5 di1 san1 sin1 ge3 jyu2 tung4 coi3, dang2 di1 siu2 peng4 jau5 sik6 dak1 gin6 hong1 di1.)
(She plans to buy some fresh fish and vegetables so that the children can eat healthier.)

點知行到半路，見到有檔賣緊懷舊玩具，阿婆即刻眼都發光。
(dim2 zi1 haang4 dou3 bun3 lou6, gin3 dou2 jau5 dong3 maai6 gan2 waai4 gau6 wun6 geoi6, aa3 po4 zik1 hak1 ngaan5 dou1 faat3 gwong1.)
(Unexpectedly, halfway there, she saw a stall selling nostalgic toys, and Grandma's eyes lit up immediately.)

佢忍唔住買咗個波子機，諗住俾啲孫仔玩，自己都想回味下童年。
(keoi5 jan2 m4 zyu6 maai5 zo2 go3 bo1 zi2 gei1, lam2 zyu6 bei2 di1 syun1 zai2 waan2, zi6 gei2 dou1 soeng2 wui4 mei6 haa5 tung4 nin4.)
(She couldn't resist buying a pinball machine, thinking of letting her grandchildren play, and wanting to relive her own childhood.)

結果，買餸嘅錢用晒嚟買玩具，今晚可能要食菜粥囉！
(git3 gwo2, maai5 sung3 ge3 cin2 jung6晒嚟買玩具，gam1 maan5 ho2 nang4 jiu3 sik6 coi3 zuk1 lo1!)
(As a result, the money for groceries was used up to buy toys, so tonight they might have to eat vegetable congee!)

錢唔係萬能

阿婆喺街市執到一蚊銀。
(aa3 po4 hai2 gaai1 si5 zap1 dou2 jat1 man1 ngan4.)
(Grandma picked up a one-dollar coin in the market.)

佢諗住買粒糖畀個孫食。
(keoi5 lam2 zyu6 maai5 lap1 tong2 bei2 go3 syun1 sik6.)
(She thought of buying a candy for her grandson.)

點知糖舖老闆話，依家一蚊買唔到糖啦。
(dim2 zi1 tong2 pou3 lou5 baan2 waa6, ji1 gaa1 jat1 man1 maai5 m4 dou2 tong2 laa1.)
(But the candy store owner said, one dollar can't buy candy anymore these days.)

阿婆笑笑口，將個銀仔放入捐款箱。
(aa3 po4 siu3 siu3 hau2, zoeng1 go3 ngan4 zai2 fong3 jap6 gyun1 fun2 soeng1.)
(Grandma smiled and put the coin into a donation box.)

雖然錢唔係萬能，但係可以帶嚟小小嘅快樂。
(seoi1 jin4 cin2 m4 hai6 maan6 nang4, daan6 hai6 ho2 ji5 daai3 lai4 siu2 siu2 ge3 faai3 lok6.)
(Although money isn't everything, it can bring a little happiness.)

神奇嘅菠蘿包

阿婆喺街市買咗個菠蘿包，熱辣辣香噴噴。
(aa3 po4 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai5 zo2 go3 bo1 lo4 baau1, jit6 laat6 laat6 hoeng1 pan3 pan3.)
(Grandma bought a pineapple bun from the market, it was piping hot and smelled delicious.)

佢諗住返屋企嘆下午茶，點知行行吓，個菠蘿包竟然識得講嘢！
(keoi5 lam2 zyu6 faan1 uk1 kei2 taan2 haa6 ng5 caa4, dim2 zi1 haang4 haang4 haa5, go3 bo1 lo4 baau1 ging2 jin4 sik1 dak1 gong2 je5!)
(She was planning to go home and enjoy afternoon tea, but as she walked, the pineapple bun suddenly started talking!)

菠蘿包話：「阿婆，我帶你去尋寶！」
(bo1 lo4 baau1 waa6: "aa3 po4, ngo5 daai3 nei5 heoi3 cam4 bou2!")
(The pineapple bun said, "Grandma, I'll take you treasure hunting!")

阿婆嚇咗一跳，但係又覺得好得意，就跟住菠蘿包跑。
(aa3 po4 haak3 zo2 jat1 tiu3, daan6 hai6 jau6 gok3 dak1 hou2 dak1 ji3, zau6 gan1 zyu6 bo1 lo4 baau1 paau2.)
(Grandma was startled, but she found it very interesting, so she followed the pineapple bun running.)

佢哋穿過公園，跳過水氹，最後喺一棵大樹下，搵到一盒金幣！
(keoi5 dei6 cyun1 gwo3 gung1 jyun2, tiu3 gwo3 seoi2 tam5, zeoi3 hau6 hai2 jat1 fo2 daai6 syu6 haa5, wan2 dou2 jat1 hap6 gam1 bai6!)
(They went through the park, jumped over puddles, and finally, under a big tree, they found a box of gold coins!)

原來個菠蘿包係神仙變嘅，專門幫助善良嘅人。
(jyun4 lai4 go3 bo1 lo4 baau1 hai6 san4 sin1 bin3 ge3, zyun1 mun4 bong1 zo6 sin6 loeng4 ge3 jan4.)
(It turned out the pineapple bun was transformed by a fairy, specifically to help kind people.)

砵仔糕歷險記

有個砵仔糕仔阿寶，好想知自己點解咁好味。
(Jau5 go3 but3 zai2 gou1 zai2 aa3 bo2, hou2 soeng2 zi1 zi6 gei2 dim2 gaai2 gam3 hou2 mei6.)
(There was a little steamed bowl pudding, Ah Bo, who really wanted to know why he was so delicious.)

佢的起心肝，跳咗落嚟，想搵答案。
(Keoi5 dik1 hei2 sam1 gon1, tiu3 zo2 lok6 lai4, soeng2 wan2 daap3 aan3.)
(He plucked up his courage, jumped down, and wanted to find the answer.)

點知一碌落去，跌咗入碗雲吞麵度！
(Dim2 zi1 jat1 luk1 lok6 heoi3, dit3 zo2 jap6 wun2 wan4 tan1 min6 dou6!)
(Unexpectedly, he tumbled down and fell into a bowl of wonton noodles!)

阿寶嚇到嘩嘩聲，好彩啲雲吞好心腸，救咗佢。
(Aa3 bo2 haak3 dou3 waa4 waa4 seng1, hou2 caai2 di1 wan4 tan1 hou2 sam1 coeng4, gau3 zo2 keoi5.)
(Ah Bo was so scared he cried out, luckily the wontons were kind and saved him.)

雲吞話：「你咁甜，溝埋我哋啲湯，咪好味囉！」
(Wan4 tan1 waa6: "Nei5 gam3 tim4, kau1 maai4 ngo5 dei6 di1 tong1, mai1 hou2 mei6 lo1!")
(The wontons said: "You're so sweet, mixed with our soup, that's why it's delicious!")

阿寶終於明白，原來合作先至最好味！
(Aa3 bo2 zung1 jyu1 ming4 baak6, jyun4 lai4 hap6 zok3 sin1 zeoi3 hou2 mei6!)
(Ah Bo finally understood, collaboration is what makes things most delicious!)

神奇雪糕車

阿婆喺街市買餸，突然見到架彩虹雪糕車。
(aa3 po4 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai5 sung3, dat6 jin4 gin3 dou2 gaa2 coi2 hung4 syut3 gou1 ce1.)
(Grandma was buying groceries at the market when she suddenly saw a rainbow-colored ice cream truck.)

佢諗起細個嘅快樂時光，忍唔住買咗杯雲呢拿雪糕。
(keoi5 nam2 hei2 sai3 go3 ge3 faai3 lok6 si4 gwong1, jan2 m4 zyu6 maai5 zo2 bui1 wan4 nei4 laa1 syut3 gou1.)
(She remembered happy times from her childhood and couldn't help but buy a cup of vanilla ice cream.)

食落第一啖，阿婆覺得好似返到後生，充滿活力！
(sik6 lok6 dai6 jat1 daam6, aa3 po4 gok3 dak1 hou2 ci5 faan1 dou3 hau6 saang1, cung1 mun5 wut6 lik6!)
(Taking the first bite, Grandma felt like she was young again, full of energy!)

原來呢架唔係普通雪糕車，係時光雪糕車嚟㗎！
(jyun4 loi4 ni1 gaa2 m4 hai6 pou2 tung1 syut3 gou1 ce1, hai6 si4 gwong1 syut3 gou1 ce1 lai4 gaa3!)
(It turned out this wasn't an ordinary ice cream truck, it was a time-traveling ice cream truck!)

阿婆笑咪咪咁講：「好彩冇錯過！」
(aa3 po4 siu3 mai1 mai1 gam2 gong2: "hou2 coi2 mou5 co3 gwo3!")
(Grandma said with a smile: "Luckily I didn't miss it!")

storyName: 阿 Abby 嘅 行山 奇遇
storyBody:
阿 Abby 嘅 行山 奇遇

阿 Abby 今日 心情 好，諗住 上山 行下。
(aa3 Abby ge3 gam1 jat6 sam1 ching4 hou2, lam2 jyu6 soeng5 saan1 haang4 haa5.)
(Abby felt great today and decided to go hiking.)

行到 半路，佢 發現 一隻 好得意 嘅 小松鼠。
(haang4 dou3 bun3 lou6, keoi5 faat3 yin6 jat1 jek3 hou2 dak1 yi3 ge3 siu2 sung1 syu2.)
(Halfway through her hike, she found a very cute little squirrel.)

隻 松鼠 手上面 捧住 一粒 好大 嘅 栗子，食得津津有味。
(jek3 sung1 syu2 sau2 soeng6 min6 pung2 jyu6 jat1 lap1 hou2 daai6 ge3 luk1 ji2, sik6 dak1 zeon1 zeon1 jau5 mei6.)
(The squirrel was holding a big chestnut in its hands, eating it with great relish.)

Abby忍唔住笑咗出嚟，覺得佢好似個細路仔。
(Abby jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3 zo2 chut1 lai4, gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 chi5 go3 sai3 lou6 zai2.)
(Abby couldn't help but laugh, thinking it looked like a little child.)

突然間，隻 松鼠 跳上 佢嘅 背囊，仲想 分啲 栗子 俾 佢添！
(dat6 jin4 gaan1, jek3 sung1 syu2 tiu3 soeng5 keoi5 ge3 bui3 nong4, jung4 soeng2 fan1 di1 luk1 ji2 bei2 keoi5 tim1!)
(Suddenly, the squirrel jumped onto her backpack and even wanted to share some chestnuts with her!)

Abby 開心到 嘩嘩 聲，覺得 今日 行山 真係 好 好玩 呀！
(Abby hoi1 sam1 dou3 waa1 waa1 seng1, gok3 dak1 gam1 jat6 haang4 saan1 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 waan2 aa3!)
(Abby was so happy she exclaimed in excitement, thinking today's hike was really fun!)

洛城掃貨記

阿婆去咗洛杉磯嘅超級市場買嘢。
(aa3 po4 heoi3 zo2 lok3 sing4 ge3 ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4 maai5 je5.)
(Grandma went to a supermarket in Los Angeles to buy things.)

佢見到啲生果又大又靚，開心到見牙唔見眼。
(keoi5 gin3 dou2 di1 saang1 gwo2 jau6 daai6 jau6 leng3, hoi1 sam1 dou3 gin3 ngaa4 m4 gin3 ngaan5.)
(She saw the fruits were so big and beautiful, she was so happy she was grinning from ear to ear.)

點知佢唔記得帶銀包，成抽生果放返低。
(dim2 zi1 keoi5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 ngan4 baau1, seng4 cau1 saang1 gwo2 fong3 faan1 dai1.)
(But then she forgot to bring her wallet and had to put all the fruits back.)

收銀姐姐見佢咁慘，送咗個橙俾佢。
(sau1 ngan2 ze2 ze1 gin3 keoi5 gam3 caam2, sung3 zo2 go3 caang2 bei2 keoi5.)
(The cashier saw how pitiful she was and gave her an orange.)

阿婆笑住話：「唔緊要，下次再嚟！」
(aa3 po4 siu3 zyu6 waa6: "m4 gan2 jiu3, haa6 ci3 zoi3 lai4!")
(Grandma said with a smile, "It's okay, I'll come again next time!")

今晚食乜好？

老闆今日心情靚靚，喺茶餐廳門口大聲問：「喂，今晚食乜好？」
(lou5 baan2 gam1 jat6 sam1 cing4 leng3 leng3, hai2 caa4 caan1 teng1 mun4 hau2 daai6 seng1 man6: "wai2, gam1 maan1 sik6 mat1 hou2?")
(The boss is in a great mood today, loudly asking at the entrance of the cha chaan teng: "Hey, what's good to eat tonight?")

佢話今日特別推介豉油皇炒麵，話保證你食到舔舔脷。
(keoi5 waa6 gam1 jat6 dak6 bit6 teoi1 gaai3 si6 jau4 wong4 caau2 min6, waa6 bou2 zing3 nei5 sik6 dou3 tim2 tim2 lei2.)
(He said today's special recommendation is soy sauce chow mein, guaranteeing you'll lick your lips after eating it.)

阿婆聽咗，笑瞇瞇咁講：「好呀，就試下你啲秘製豉油皇，睇下係咪真係咁巴閉！」
(aa3 po4 teng1 zo2, siu3 mi1 mi1 gam2 gong2: "hou2 aa3, zau6 si3 haa5 nei5 di1 bei3 zai3 si6 jau4 wong4, tai2 haa5 hai6 mai1 zan1 hai6 gam3 baa1 bai3!")
(The grandma heard this and said with a smile: "Okay, I'll try your secret soy sauce, and see if it's really that amazing!")

點知食完，阿婆豎起拇指：「唔錯唔錯，真係好好味，老闆你真係有料到！」
(dim2 zi1 sik6 jyun4, aa3 po4 syu6 hei2 mou5 zi2: "m4 co3 m4 co3, zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 mei6, lou5 baan2 nei5 zan1 hai6 jau5 liu2 dou3!")
(Unexpectedly, after eating it, the grandma gave a thumbs up: "Not bad, not bad, it's really delicious, boss you really are something!")

老闆聽見，笑到見牙唔見眼，話聽日再嚟，包你有驚喜！
(lou5 baan2 teng1 gin3, siu3 dou3 gin3 ngaa4 m4 gin3 ngaan5, waa6 ting1 jat6 zoi3 lai4, baau1 jau5 nei5 geng1 hei2!)
(The boss heard this and smiled so wide you couldn't see his eyes, saying come again tomorrow, I guarantee you'll be surprised!)

太空機械人郊遊

啲太空機械人放假，諗住去郊遊輕鬆下。
(di1 taai3 hung1 gei1 haai6 jan4 fong3 gaa3, nam2 zyu6 heoi3 gaau1 jau4 hing1 sung1 haa5.)
(The space robots were on vacation, thinking of going on a picnic to relax.)

佢哋帶咗好多螺絲批同埋偈油當零食。
(keoi5 dei6 daai3 zo2 hou2 do1 lo4 si1 pai1 tung4 mai4 gai2 jau4 dong3 ling4 sik6.)
(They brought a lot of screwdrivers and engine oil as snacks.)

點知去到火星，發現啲火星人原來好鍾意跳廣場舞！
(dim2 zi1 heoi3 dou3 fo2 sing1, faat3 jin6 di1 fo2 sing1 jan4 jyun4 lai4 hou2 zung1 ji3 tiu3 gwong2 coeng4 mou5!)
(Unexpectedly, when they arrived on Mars, they discovered that the Martians really loved doing square dancing!)

啲機械人覺得好得意，即刻拎出佢哋嘅零件，一齊跟住跳。
(di1 gei1 haai6 jan4 gok3 dak1 hou2 dak1 ji3, zik1 hak1 ling1 ceot1 keoi5 dei6 ge3 ling4 gin2, jat1 cai4 gan1 zyu6 tiu3.)
(The robots found it very interesting, immediately took out their spare parts, and danced along together.)

結果，成個火星變咗一個大型機械人廣場舞派對！
(git3 gwo2, seng4 go3 fo2 sing1 bin3 zo2 jat1 go3 daai6 hing4 gei1 haai6 jan4 gwong2 coeng4 mou5 paai3 deoi2!)
(As a result, the entire Mars turned into a huge robot square dancing party!)

點心歷險記

阿婆今朝起身，話想去飲茶。
(aa3 po4 gam1 ziu1 hei2 san1, waa6 soeng2 heoi3 jam2 caa4.)
(Grandma woke up this morning and said she wanted to go for dim sum.)

佢最鍾意食嘅叉燒包，永遠都係第一選擇。
(keoi5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 ge3 caa1 siu1 baau1, wing5 jyun5 dou1 hai6 dai6 jat1 syun2 zaak6.)
(Her favorite char siu bao is always her first choice.)

點知去到茶樓，竟然賣晒叉燒包！
(dim2 zi1 heoi3 dou3 caa4 lau4, ging2 jin4 maai6 saai3 caa1 siu1 baau1!)
(But when we got to the tea house, they were completely sold out of char siu bao!)

阿婆失望到個樣都扁晒，好似個皺皮柑咁。
(aa3 po4 sat1 mong6 dou3 go3 joeng2 dou1 bin2 saai3, hou2 ci5 go3 zau3 pei4 gam1 gam2.)
(Grandma was so disappointed her face drooped, like a wrinkly tangerine.)

點心姐姐見到，偷偷地拎咗個隱藏版嘅蜜汁叉燒包俾佢。
(dim2 sam1 ge3 ge1 zi2 gin3 dou2, tau1 tau1 dei6 ling1 zo2 go3 jan2 cong4 baan2 ge3 mat6 zap1 caa1 siu1 baau1 bei2 keoi5.)
(The dim sum lady, seeing this, secretly brought out a hidden version of honey-glazed char siu bao for her.)

阿婆食完，笑到見牙唔見眼，話好味過平時嗰啲！
(aa3 po4 sik6 jyun4, siu3 dou3 gin3 ngaa4 m4 gin3 ngaan5, waa6 hou2 mei6 gwo3 ping4 si4 go2 di1!)
(After Grandma ate it, she smiled so much you couldn't see her eyes and said it tasted even better than the usual ones!)

瞓醒梳乎厘

阿婆日日都好準時起身飲茶。
(aa3 po4 jat6 jat6 dou1 hou2 zeon2 si4 hei2 san1 jam2 caa4.)
(Grandma gets up to drink tea every day right on time.)

佢話飲完茶，個人精神啲。
(keoi5 waa6 jam2 jyun4 caa4, go3 jan4 zing1 san4 di1.)
(She says that after drinking tea, she feels more energetic.)

今日佢決定試吓整梳乎厘食。
(gam1 jat6 keoi5 kyut3 ding6 si3 haa5 zing2 so1 fu1 lei4 sik6.)
(Today she decided to try making souffle to eat.)

點知焗出嚟，梳乎厘塌晒。
(dim2 zi1 guk6 ceot1 lei4, so1 fu1 lei4 taap3晒.)
(Who knew when it came out of the oven, the souffle had completely collapsed.)

阿婆笑住話：「都係飲茶穩陣啲！」
(aa3 po4 siu3 zoek6 waa6: "dou1 hai6 jam2 caa4 wan2 zan6 di1!")
(Grandma said with a smile, "It's still safer to drink tea!")

古老電車奇遇

阿婆搭叮叮，諗住去飲茶。
(aa3 po4 daap3 ding1 ding1, nam2 zyu6 heoi3 jam2 caa4.)
(Grandma took the tram, thinking of going for dim sum.)

點知架車，呠一聲，飛咗上天！
(dim2 zi1 gaa3 ce1, ban3 jat1 seng1, fei1 zo2 soeng5 tin1!)
(Who knew the tram, with a "honk," flew into the sky!)

阿婆嚇一跳，但係見到維港變得好細。
(aa3 po4 haak3 jat1 tiu3, daan6 hai6 gin3 dou3 wai4 gong2 bin3 dak1 hou2 sai3.)
(Grandma was startled, but saw Victoria Harbour become very small.)

車長笑咪咪，話今日特別線，直達月亮茶樓。
(ce1 zoeng2 siu3 mi1 mi1, waa6 gam1 jat6 dak6 bit3 sin3, zik6 daat6 jyut6 loeng4 caa4 lau4.)
(The driver smiled and said today was a special route, direct to the Moon Teahouse.)

月亮茶樓好多人，嫦娥請阿婆食蝦餃。
(jyut6 loeng4 caa4 lau4 hou2 do1 jan4, soeng4 ngo4 ceng2 aa3 po4 sik6 haa1 gaau2.)
(The Moon Teahouse was crowded, and Chang'e treated Grandma to shrimp dumplings.)

阿婆食到笑呵呵，話下次都要再搭飛天叮叮。
(aa3 po4 sik6 dou3 siu3 ho1 ho1, waa6 haa6 ci3 dou1 jiu3 zoi3 daap3 fei1 tin1 ding1 ding1.)
(Grandma ate and laughed heartily, saying she wanted to ride the flying tram again next time.)

消失嘅菠蘿包

阿婆今朝去咗茶餐廳，想食個熱辣辣嘅菠蘿包。
(aa3 po4 gam1 ziu1 heoi3 zo2 caa4 caan1 teng1, soeng2 sik6 go3 jit6 laat6 laat6 ge3 bo1 lo4 baau1.)
(Grandma went to the tea restaurant this morning, wanting to eat a piping hot pineapple bun.)

點知一轉身，個菠蘿包唔見咗，得返個紙袋。
(dim2 zi1 jat1 zyun2 san1, go3 bo1 lo4 baau1 m4 gin3 zo2, dak1 faan1 go3 zi2 doi2.)
(But then she turned around, and the pineapple bun was gone, only a paper bag remained.)

阿婆覺得好奇怪，周圍望下，見到隻貓仔偷偷地舔緊嘴角。
(aa3 po4 gok3 dak1 hou2 kei4 gwaai3, zau1 wai4 mong6 haa5, gin3 dou2 zek3 maau1 zai2 tau1 tau1 dei6 tim2 gan2 zeoi2 gok3.)
(Grandma felt it was very strange, looked around, and saw a kitten secretly licking its mouth.)

原來係隻貓仔偷食咗阿婆嘅菠蘿包！
(jyun4 lai4 hai6 zek3 maau1 zai2 tau1 sik6 zo2 aa3 po4 ge3 bo1 lo4 baau1!)
(Turns out it was the kitten who stole Grandma's pineapple bun!)

阿婆冇嬲，反而覺得好得意，買多咗個包俾貓仔食。
(aa3 po4 mou5 nau1, faan2 ji4 gok3 dak1 hou2 dak1 ji3, maai5 do1 zo2 go3 baau1 bei2 maau1 zai2 sik6.)
(Grandma wasn't angry, but instead found it amusing, and bought another bun for the kitten to eat.)

神奇雪糕車

架雪糕車識得講嘢，你信唔信？
(gaa3 syut3 gou1 ce1 sik1 dak1 gong2 je5, nei5 seon3 m4 seon3?)
(Do you believe that an ice cream truck can talk?)

佢每日黃昏都喺公園出現，賣嘅雪糕味道古靈精怪。
(keoi5 mui5 jat6 wong4 fan1 dou1 hai2 gung1 jyun2 ceot1 hin3, maai6 ge3 syut3 gou1 mei6 dou6 gu2 ling4 zing1 gwaai3.)
(It appears in the park every evening, selling ice cream with bizarre flavors.)

有個細路仔買咗個鹹魚味雪糕，一食落去，即刻識得游水！
(jau5 go3 sai3 lou6 zai2 maai5 zo2 go3 haam4 yu2 mei6 syut3 gou1, jat1 sik6 lok6 heoi3, zik1 hak1 sik1 dak1 jau4 seoi2!)
(A little boy bought a salted fish flavored ice cream, and as soon as he ate it, he suddenly knew how to swim!)

另一個阿婆買咗個麻雀味雪糕，返到屋企就贏晒啲牌！
(ling6 jat1 go3 aa3 po4 maai5 zo2 go3 maa4 zoek3 mei6 syut3 gou1, faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 zau6 wing4 saai3 di1 paai2!)
(Another old woman bought a mahjong flavored ice cream, and when she got home, she won all her games!)

原來，架雪糕車賣嘅唔係雪糕，係願望！
(jyun4 loi4, gaa3 syut3 gou1 ce1 maai6 ge3 m4 hai6 syut3 gou1, hai6 jyun6 mong6!)
(Turns out, the ice cream truck wasn't selling ice cream, but wishes!)

阿婆嘅秘密花園

阿婆喺後花園種咗好多奇奇怪怪嘅花，啲花識唱歌㗎！
(aa3 po4 hai2 hau6 faa1 jyun2 zung3 zo2 hou2 do1 kei4 kei4 gwaai3 gwaai3 ge3 faa1, di1 faa1 sik1 cheung3 go1 gaa3!)
(Grandma planted many strange and peculiar flowers in her backyard; these flowers know how to sing!)

有一日，小明偷偷地走入去，想聽下啲花唱咩。
(jau5 jat1 jat6, siu2 ming4 tau1 tau1 dei6 zau2 jap6 heoi3, seung2 teng1 haa5 di1 faa1 cheung3 me1.)
(One day, Siu Ming secretly went inside, wanting to hear what the flowers were singing.)

點知啲花見到佢，就唱咗一首好好笑嘅歌，講佢成日唔沖涼。
(dim2 ji1 di1 faa1 gin3 dou2 keoi5, zau6 cheung3 zo2 jat1 sau2 hou2 hou2 siu3 ge3 go1, gong2 keoi5 sing4 jat6 m4 chung1 leung4.)
(Unexpectedly, when the flowers saw him, they sang a very funny song, talking about how he never takes a bath.)

小明覺得好尷尬，即刻面紅晒，嗱嗱聲走咗。
(siu2 ming4 gok3 dak1 hou2 gaam3 gaai3, jik1 hak1 min6 hung4 saai3, naa4 naa4 seng1 zau2 zo2.)
(Siu Ming felt very embarrassed, his face immediately turned red, and he quickly left.)

之後，佢每日都乖乖地沖涼，啲花就唱返啲好聽嘅歌俾佢聽喇。
(zi1 hau6, keoi5 mui5 jat6 dou1 gwaai1 gwaai1 dei6 chung1 leung4, di1 faa1 zau6 cheung3 faan1 di1 hou2 teng1 ge3 go1 bei2 keoi5 teng1 laa3.)
(After that, he obediently took a bath every day, and the flowers sang nice songs for him to listen to.)

消失嘅菠蘿包

阿輝今日諗住買個菠蘿包做早餐，點知賣晒。
(aa3 fai1 gam1 jat6 nam2 zeoi6 maai5 go3 bo1 lo4 baau1 zou6 zou2 caan1, dim2 zi1 maai6 saai3.)
(Ah Fai planned to buy a pineapple bun for breakfast today, but they were all sold out.)

佢好失望，但係轉個頭就見到 Fritz 隻狗仔口入面咬住個菠蘿包。
(keoi5 hou2 sat1 mong6, daan6 hai6 zyun2 go3 tau4 zau6 gin3 dou2 Fritz zek3 gau2 zai2 hau2 jap6 min6 ngaau5 zyu6 go3 bo1 lo4 baau1.)
(He was very disappointed, but then he saw Fritz the dog holding a pineapple bun in its mouth.)

阿輝問 Fritz 攞返個包，Fritz 擰頭唔肯。
(aa3 fai1 man6 Fritz lo2 faan1 go3 baau1, Fritz ning6 tau4 m4 hang2.)
(Ah Fai asked Fritz for the bun back, but Fritz shook its head and refused.)

原來 Fritz 見到阿輝咁唔開心，想分啲開心俾佢。
(jyun4 lai4 Fritz gin3 dou2 aa3 fai1 gam3 m4 hoi1 sam1, soeng2 fan1 di1 hoi1 sam1 bei2 keoi5.)
(It turned out that Fritz saw Ah Fai was so unhappy and wanted to share some happiness with him.)

阿輝覺得又嬲又好笑，最後同 Fritz 一齊分享咗個菠蘿包。
(aa3 fai1 gok3 dak1 jau6 nau1 jau6 hou2 siu3, zeoi3 hau6 tung4 Fritz jat1 cai4 fan1 hoeng2 zo2 go3 bo1 lo4 baau1.)
(Ah Fai felt both angry and amused, and in the end, he shared the pineapple bun with Fritz.)

瞓覺奇遇

阿 Fritz 瞓覺嗰陣，夢見自己變咗一隻識飛嘅燒賣。
(aa3 Fritz fan3 gaau3 go2 zan6, mung6 gin3 zi6 gei2 bin3 zo2 jat1 zek3 sik1 fei1 ge3 siu1 maai2.)
(When Fritz fell asleep, he dreamt that he turned into a flying siu mai.)

佢喺點心嘅雲海上面飛嚟飛去，好得意呀！
(keoi5 hai2 dim2 sam1 ge3 wan4 hoi2 soeng6 min6 fei1 lai4 fei1 heoi3, hou2 dak1 ji3 aa3!)
(He flew around above a sea of dim sum, how interesting!)

突然間，一隻巨型筷子飛過嚟，想夾佢！
(dat6 jin4 gaan1, jat1 zek3 geoi6 jing4 faai3 zi2 fei1 gwo3 lai4, soeng2 gaap3 keoi5!)
(Suddenly, a giant chopstick flew over, wanting to grab him!)

阿 Fritz 嚇到醒咗，原來係佢阿媽叫佢起身返學。
(aa3 Fritz haak3 dou3 sing2 zo2, jyun4 lai4 hai6 keoi5 aa3 maa1 giu3 keoi5 hei2 san1 faan1 hok6.)
(Fritz was so scared he woke up, it turned out to be his mum calling him to get up and go to school.)

佢諗返個夢，忍唔住笑咗出嚟，燒賣真係好搞嘢！
(keoi5 lam2 faan1 go3 mung6, jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3 zo2 chut1 lai4, siu1 maai2 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaau2 je5!)
(He thought back to the dream, couldn't help but laugh, siu mai are really funny!)

月光下的貓

月光光，照住隻肥嘟嘟嘅貓。
(jyut6 gwong1 gwong1, ziu3 zyu6 zek3 fei4 du1 du1 ge3 maau1.)
(The moonlight shines on a chubby cat.)

佢瞓喺屋頂上面，發緊甜夢。
(keoi5 fan3 hai2 uk1 ding2 soeng6 min6, faat3 gan2 tim4 mung6.)
(It's sleeping on the rooftop, having sweet dreams.)

突然間，佢夢見自己變成一隻老虎，好威猛㗎！
(dat6 jin4 gaan1, keoi5 mung6 gin3 zi6 gei2 bin3 sing4 jat1 zek3 lou5 fu2, hou2 wai1 maang5 gaa3!)
(Suddenly, it dreamt it became a tiger, so powerful!)

但係一醒返，都係一隻懶洋洋嘅貓仔。
(daan6 hai6 jat1 sing2 faan1, dou1 hai6 jat1 zek3 laan5 joeng4 joeng4 ge3 maau1 zai2.)
(But when it woke up, it was still just a lazy kitten.)

佢伸個懶腰，又繼續瞓覺咯。
(keoi5 san1 go3 laan5 jiu1, jau6 gai3 zuk6 fan3 gaau3 lok3.)
(It stretched lazily and went back to sleep.)

瞓覺覺豬

阿嫲話：「乖孫，眼瞓喇，快啲瞓覺覺豬啦！」
(aa3 maa4 waa6: "gwaai1 syun1, ngaan5 fan3 laa3, faai3 di1 fan3 gaau3 gaau3 zyu1 laa3!")
(Grandma said, "Good grandchild, you're sleepy, go to sleep quickly!")

小明攬住佢嘅熊仔，打晒呵欠。
(siu2 ming4 laam5 zyu6 keoi5 ge3 hung4 zai2, daa2 saai3 ho1 him3.)
(Little Ming hugged his teddy bear, yawning all the time.)

佢問阿嫲：「瞓覺覺豬會唔會發夢見到識飛嘅燒賣呀？」
(keoi5 man6 aa3 maa4: "fan3 gaau3 gaau3 zyu1 wui5 m4 wui5 faat3 mung6 gin3 dou3 sik1 fei1 ge3 siu1 maai2 aa3?")
(He asked Grandma, "Will sleeping make me dream of siu mai that can fly?")

阿嫲笑住話：「傻仔，瞓覺就有機會乜都見到㗎啦！」
(aa3 maa4 siu3 zyu6 waa6: "so4 zai2, fan3 gaau3 zau6 jau5 gei1 wui5 mat1 dou1 gin3 dou3 gaa3 laa1!")
(Grandma said with a smile, "Silly boy, if you sleep, you have the chance to see anything!")

小明聽完，即刻合埋眼，希望夢到一籠識飛嘅燒賣請佢食。
(siu2 ming4 ting1 jyun4, zik1 hak1 hap6 maai4 ngaan5, hei1 mong6 mung6 dou3 jat1 lung4 sik1 fei1 ge3 siu1 maai2 ceng2 keoi5 sik6.)
(Little Ming listened and immediately closed his eyes, hoping to dream of a basket of flying siu mai inviting him to eat.)

消失咗嘅菠蘿包

細蚊仔阿強，最鍾意食街口嘅菠蘿包。
(sai3 man1 zai2 aa3 koeng4, zeoi3 zung1 yi3 sik6 gaai1 hau2 ge3 bo1 lo4 baau1.)
(Little Ah Keung loved eating the pineapple buns from the street corner the most.)

有一日，佢好開心咁買咗個熱辣辣嘅菠蘿包，點知行行下唔見咗！
(jau5 jat1 jat6, keoi5 hou2 hoi1 sam1 gam2 maai5 zo2 go3 jit6 laat6 laat6 ge3 bo1 lo4 baau1, dim2 zi1 haang4 haang4 haa2 m4 gin3 zo2!)
(One day, he happily bought a piping hot pineapple bun, but unexpectedly it disappeared while he was walking!)

阿強勁唔開心，周圍搵都搵唔到。
(aa3 koeng4 ging6 m4 hoi1 sam1, zau1 wai4 wan2 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2.)
(Ah Keung was very unhappy and couldn't find it anywhere he looked.)

突然間，佢聽到把細細聲嘅「呵呵」笑聲，原來係隻小老鼠偷咗佢個包！
(dat6 jin4 gaan1, keoi5 ting1 dou2 baa2 sai3 sai3 seng1 ge3 "ho4 ho4" siu3 seng1, jyun4 lai4 hai6 zek3 siu2 lou5 syu2 tau1 zo2 keoi5 go3 baau1!)
(Suddenly, he heard a faint "hehe" laughing sound, and it turned out a little mouse had stolen his bun!)

阿強見到小老鼠食得咁開心，心諗：「算啦，下次再買過啦。」
(aa3 koeng4 gin3 dou2 siu2 lou5 syu2 sik6 dak1 gam3 hoi1 sam1, sam1 nim2: "syun3 laa1, haa6 ci3 zoi3 maai5 gwo3 laa1.")
(Seeing the little mouse eating so happily, Ah Keung thought, "Never mind, I'll just buy another one next time.")

佢覺得，俾小動物食都好過丟咗。
(keoi5 gok3 dak1, bei2 siu2 dung6 mat6 sik6 dou1 hou2 gwo3 diu1 zo2.)
(He felt that it was better for a small animal to eat it than for it to be wasted.)

阿婆嘅秘密花園

阿婆後花園有棵好得意嘅樹，識得講嘢㗎！
(aa3 po4 hau6 faa1 jyun4 jau5 ko2 hou2 dak1 ji3 ge3 syu6, sik1 dak1 gong2嘢 gaa3!)
(Grandma's backyard has a very interesting tree that can talk!)

佢成日問：「今日有冇新嘅故仔聽呀？」
(keoi5 seng4 jat6 man6: "gam1 jat6 jau5 mou5 san1 ge3 gu3 zai2 teng1 aa3?")
(It always asks, "Do you have any new stories to tell today?")

阿婆就笑咪咪咁，講啲舊時嘅嘢畀佢聽。
(aa3 po4 zau6 siu3 mi1 mi1 gam2, gong2 di1 gau6 si4 ge3 je5 bei2 keoi5 teng1.)
(Grandma smiles and tells it old stories from the past.)

有一日，棵樹竟然跌咗好多閃令令嘅星星落嚟！
(jau5 jat1 jat6, ko2 syu6 ging2 jin4 dit3 zo2 hou2 do1 sim2 ling1 ling1 ge3 sing1 sing1 lok6 lai4!)
(One day, the tree actually dropped a lot of sparkling stars!)

阿婆執起啲星星，發現每粒都係一個好好嘅回憶。
(aa3 po4 zap1 hei2 di1 sing1 sing1, faat3 jin6 mui5 lap1 dou1 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 hou2 ge3 wui4 jik1.)
(Grandma picked up the stars and discovered each one was a beautiful memory.)

原來棵樹係用回憶嚟開花結果㗎！
(jyun4 lai4 ko2 syu6 hai6 jung6 wui4 jik1 lai4 hoi1 faa1 git3 gwo2 gaa3!)
(It turns out the tree uses memories to bloom and bear fruit!)

消失咗嘅菠蘿包

我阿嫲今日去咗茶餐廳，諗住買個熱辣辣嘅菠蘿包。
(ngo5 aa3 po4 gam1 jat6 heoi3 zo2 caa4 caan1 teng1, lam2 zyu6 maai5 go3 jit6 laat6 laat6 ge3 bo1 lo4 baau1.)
(My grandma went to the tea restaurant today, thinking of buying a hot pineapple bun.)

點知佢行到麵包櫃前面，發現啲菠蘿包唔見曬！
(dim2 zi1 keoi5 haang4 dou3 min6 baau1 gwai6 cin4 min6, faat3 jin6 di1 bo1 lo4 baau1 m4 gin3 saai3!)
(But when she walked in front of the bread display, she discovered all the pineapple buns were gone!)

個老闆笑瞇瞇噉話：「啱啱俾隻識講嘢嘅貓仔 Fritz 食曬喇！」
(go3 lou5 baan2 siu3 mei1 mei1 gam2 waa6: "ngaam1 ngaam1 bei2 zek3 sik1 gong2 je5 ge3 maau1 zai2 Fritz sik6 saai3 laa3!")
(The owner said with a smile: "Just now a talking kitten named Fritz ate them all!")

阿嫲唔信，但係聽到「喵」一聲，就見到 Fritz 舔緊嘴仔。
(aa3 po4 m4 seon3, daan6 hai6 teng1 dou3 "miu1" jat1 seng1, zau6 gin3 dou3 Fritz tim2 gan2 zeoi2 zai2.)
(Grandma didn't believe it, but when she heard a "meow," she saw Fritz licking his lips.)

Fritz 好得意噉講：「好味呀，仲有冇呀？」
(Fritz hou2 dak1 ji3 gam2 gong2: "hou2 mei6 aa3, zung6 jau5 mou5 aa3?")
(Fritz said cutely, "Delicious, are there any more?")

阿嫲忍唔住笑咗出嚟，覺得 Fritz 真係太盞鬼喇！
(aa3 po4 jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3 zo2 ceot1 lai4, gok3 dak1 Fritz zan1 hai6 taai3 zaan2 gwai2 laa3!)
(Grandma couldn't help but laugh, thinking Fritz was really too funny!)

小貓咪嘅秘密花園

阿婆後花園有一隻好得意嘅小貓咪。
(aa3 po4 hau6 faa1 jyun4 jau5 jat1 zek3 hou2 dak1 ji3 ge3 siu2 maau1 mi1.)
(Grandma's backyard has a very cute little kitten.)

佢成日偷偷雞走入去玩。
(keoi5 seng4 jat6 tau1 tau1 gai1 zau2 jap6 heoi3 waan2.)
(It always secretly sneaks in to play.)

有一日，我跟住佢，發現花園入面有一棵識唱歌嘅樹！
(jau5 jat1 jat6, ngo5 gan1 zyu6 keoi5, faat3 jin6 faa1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 fo2 sik1 coeng3 go1 ge3 syu6!)
(One day, I followed it and discovered there was a singing tree in the garden!)

小貓咪聽到歌聲，開心到喺度跳舞。
(siu2 maau1 mi1 ting1 dou2 go1 seng1, hoi1 sam1 dou3 hai2 dou6 tiu3 mou5.)
(The kitten heard the singing and was so happy it danced.)

原來花園係小貓咪同埋棵樹嘅秘密基地呀！
(jyun4 loi4 faa1 jyun4 hai6 siu2 maau1 mi1 tung4 maai4 fo2 syu6 ge3 bei3 mat6 gei1 dei6 aa3!)
(So the garden is the kitten and the tree's secret base!)

神仙雪糕車

Cherita鍾意食雪糕，日日都去士多買。
(Cherita zung1 ji3 sik6 syut3 gou1, jat1 jat1 dou1 heoi3 si6 do1 maai5.)
(Cherita loves to eat ice cream, and goes to the store to buy it every day.)

有日佢見到架七彩繽紛嘅雪糕車，車上面寫住「神仙雪糕」。
(jau5 jat1 jat6 keoi5 gin3 dou2 gaa2 cat1 coi2 ban1 fan1 ge3 syut3 gou1 che1, che1 soeng6 min6 se2 zyu6 "san4 sin1 syut3 gou1".)
(One day she saw a colorful ice cream truck, with "Fairy Ice Cream" written on it.)

Cheryl喺雪糕車入面，笑眯眯咁問：「你想食咩味呀？」
(Cheryl hai2 syut3 gou1 che1 jap6 min6, siu3 mi1 mi1 gam2 man6: "nei5 soeng2 sik6 me1 mei6 aa3?")
(Cheryl was inside the ice cream truck, smiling and asked, "What flavor would you like?")

Cherita話要彩虹味， Cheryl就變咗一個真嘅彩虹雪糕俾佢。
(Cherita waa6 jiu3 coi2 hung4 mei6, Cheryl zau6 bin3 zo2 jat1 go3 zan1 ge3 coi2 hung4 syut3 gou1 bei2 keoi5.)
(Cherita said she wanted rainbow flavor, and Cheryl turned it into a real rainbow ice cream for her.)

食完之後，Cherita識得飛，原來 Cheryl真係神仙嚟㗎！
(sik6 jyun4 zi1 hau6, Cherita sik1 dak1 fei1, jyun4 lai4 Cheryl zan1 hai6 san4 sin1 lei4 gaa3!)
(After eating it, Cherita could fly, it turned out Cheryl really was a fairy!)

storyName: 阿 Fritz 嘅 秘密
storyBody:
阿 Fritz 嘅 秘密

阿Fritz鍾意偷偷地喺公園嘅長櫈底度瞓晏覺。
(aa3 Fritz zung1 ji3 tau1 tau1 dei6 hai2 gung1 jyun2 ge3 coeng4 dang3 dai2 dou6 fan3 aan3 gaau3.)
(Fritz likes to secretly nap under the park bench.)

佢諗住冇人知，點知啲雀仔全部睇住晒。
(keoi5 lam2 zyu6 mou5 jan4 zi1, dim2 zi1 di1 zoek3 zai2 cyun4 bou6 tai2 zyu6 saai3.)
(He thought nobody knew, but the birds were watching everything.)

有一日，佢瞓醒，發現自己嘅頭上面戴住一頂用樹葉整嘅皇冠。
(jau5 jat1 jat6, keoi5 fan3 sing2, faat3 jin6 zi6 gei2 ge3 tau4 soeng6 min6 daai3 zyu6 jat1 ding2 jung6 syu6 jip6 zing2 ge3 wong4 gun1.)
(One day, he woke up and found a crown made of leaves on his head.)

原來啲雀仔覺得佢瞓覺嘅樣好得意，想封佢做「瞓覺大王」。
(jyun4 lai4 di1 zoek3 zai2 gok3 dak1 keoi5 fan3 gaau3 ge3 joeng2 hou2 dak1 ji3, soeng2 fung1 keoi5 zou6 "fan3 gaau3 daai6 wong4".)
(It turned out the birds thought he looked funny when he slept and wanted to crown him the "Sleeping King.")

阿Fritz笑到碌地，以後瞓晏覺都覺得特別開心。
(aa3 Fritz siu3 dou3 luk1 dei6, ji5 hau6 fan3 aan3 gaau3 dou1 gok3 dak1 dak6 bit3 hoi1 sam1.)
(Fritz laughed so hard he rolled on the ground, and felt extra happy napping afterwards.)

阿婆嘅秘密花園

阿婆後花園種咗好多靚靚嘅花。
(aa3 po4 hau6 faa1 jyun4 zung3 zo2 hou2 do1 leng3 leng3 ge3 faa1.)
(Grandma's backyard has planted many beautiful flowers.)

每日朝早，佢都會同啲花傾偈。
(mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2, keoi5 dou1 wui5 tung4 di1 faa1 king1 gai2.)
(Every morning, she would chat with the flowers.)

有一日，小明發現啲花識得笑！
(jau5 jat1 jat6, siu2 ming4 faat3 jin6 di1 faa1 sik1 dak1 siu3!)
(One day, Siu Ming discovered the flowers could smile!)

原來阿婆用愛心同快樂嚟種花。
(jyun4 lai4 aa3 po4 jung6 oi3 sam1 tung4 faai3 lok6 lai4 zung3 faa1.)
(Turns out Grandma uses love and happiness to grow the flowers.)

啲花感受到，所以咪笑囉！
(di1 faa1 gam2 sau6 dou2, so2 ji5 mai1 siu3 lo1!)
(The flowers could feel it, that's why they smile!)

瞓覺覺豬

阿仔唔肯瞓覺，話床下底有怪獸。
(aa3 zai2 m4 hang2 fan3 gaau3, waa6 cong4 haa6 dai2 jau5 gwaai3 sau3.)
(The little boy refused to sleep, saying there was a monster under the bed.)

媽媽話：「唔使驚，我哋用枕頭掟走佢！」
(maa4 maa1 waa6: "m4 sai2 geng1, ngo5 dei6 jung6 zam2 tau4 deng3 zau2 keoi5!")
(Mom said, "Don't be afraid, we'll throw pillows at it to chase it away!")

阿仔笑住攞起枕頭，大力掟向床下底。
(aa3 zai2 siu3 zoek3 lo2 hei2 zam2 tau4, daai6 lik6 deng3 hoeng3 cong4 haa6 dai2.)
(The little boy smiled, picked up a pillow, and threw it hard under the bed.)

點知掟中咗隻貓，佢喵喵叫咗兩聲。
(dim2 zi1 deng3 zung3 zo2 zek3 maau1, keoi5 miu1 miu1 giu3 zo2 loeng5 seng1.)
(Turns out he hit a cat, and it meowed twice.)

原來怪獸係屋企隻貓嚟㗎，阿仔即刻瞓得好甜。
(jyun4 loi4 gwaai3 sau3 hai6 uk1 kei2 zek3 maau1 lai4 gaa3, aa3 zai2 zik1 hak1 fan3 dak1 hou2 tim4.)
(It turned out the monster was just the cat, and the little boy fell asleep sweetly right away.)

尋找消失嘅貓貓

阿婆今朝起身，發現佢隻貓貓花 Fritz 唔見咗。
(aa3 po4 gam1 zaau1 hei2 san1, faat3 hin3 keoi5 zek3 maau1 maau1 faa1 Fritz m4 gin3 zo2.)
(Grandma woke up this morning and discovered that her cat Fritz was missing.)

佢即刻衝落街，大聲叫 "Fritz! Fritz! 你喺邊呀？"
(keoi5 zik1 hak1 cung1 lok6 gaai1, daai6 seng1 giu3 "Fritz! Fritz! nei5 hai2 bin1 aa3?")
(She immediately rushed downstairs, shouting loudly "Fritz! Fritz! Where are you?")

街坊都幫手搵，但係都搵唔到。
(gaai1 fong1 dou1 bong1 sau2 wan2, daan6 hai6 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2.)
(The neighbors all helped to look, but they couldn't find him.)

突然，有個人指住間電腦舖， "喺嗰度！"
(dat6 jin4, jau5 go3 jan4 zi2 zyu6 gaan1 din6 nou5 pou3, "hai2 go2 dou6!")
(Suddenly, someone pointed at a computer shop, "He's there!")

阿婆行埋去，見到 Fritz 瞓喺部 Linux 電腦上面，呼呼大睡。
(aa3 po4 haang4 maai4 heoi3, gin3 dou2 Fritz fan3 hai2 bou6 Linux din6 nou5 soeng6 min6, fu1 fu1 daai6 seoi6.)
(Grandma walked over and saw Fritz sleeping soundly on top of a Linux computer.)

原來 Fritz 鍾意 Linux 嘅暖暖嘅風扇風！
(jyun4 lai4 Fritz zung1 ji3 Linux ge3 nuun5 nuun5 ge3 fung1 sin3 fung1!)
(Turns out Fritz loves the warm fan air from the Linux computer!)

阿婆笑住抱起 Fritz, "你呢隻衰仔！"
(aa3 po4 siu3 zyu6 pou5 hei2 Fritz, "nei5 ni1 zek3 seoi1 zai2!")
(Grandma smiled and picked up Fritz, "You naughty boy!")

騎呢貓咪學講嘢

有隻得意嘅貓咪叫咪咪，佢日日都扭計要學人講嘢。
(jau5 zek3 dak1 ji3 ge3 maau1 mi1 giu3 mai1 mi1, keoi5 jat1 jat1 dou1 nau2 gai2 jiu3 hok6 jan4 gong2 je5.)
(There's a cute cat named Mimi who insisted on learning to talk like people every day.)

佢成日跟住婆婆後面，咿咿呀呀咁。
(keoi5 seng4 jat6 gan1 zyu6 po4 po4 hau6 min6, ji1 ji1 aa1 aa1 gam2.)
(She would always follow behind Grandma, babbling and mumbling.)

有一日，婆婆教佢講：「你好！」
(jau5 jat1 jat6, po4 po4 gaau3 keoi5 gong2: "nei5 hou2!")
(One day, Grandma taught her to say, "Hello!")

咪咪努力咁試，點知出咗句：「喵嗚！」
(mai1 mi1 nu5 lik6 gam2 si3, dim2 zi1 ceot1 zo2 geoi3: "miu1 wu1!")
(Mimi tried her best, but what came out was, "Meow!")

婆婆笑到彎晒腰，話咪咪講貓語都好可愛。
(po4 po4 siu3 dou3 waan1 saai3 jiu1, waa6 mai1 mi1 gong2 maau1 jyu5 dou1 hou2 ho2 oi3.)
(Grandma laughed so hard she bent over, saying Mimi was cute even when speaking cat language.)

咪咪聽完，就更加大聲咁：「喵喵喵！」
(mai1 mi1 ting1 jyun4, zau6 gang3 gaa1 daai6 seng1 gam2: "miu1 miu1 miu1!")
(After hearing that, Mimi meowed even louder: "Meow meow meow!")

月光光許願記

今晚嘅月光圓碌碌，好似隻大蛋黃咁。
(gam1 maan1 ge3 jyut6 gwong1 jyun4 luk1 luk1, hou2 ci5 zek3 daai6 daan6 wong4 gam3.)
(Tonight's moon is perfectly round, like a big egg yolk.)

阿婆話見到月光，就要快啲許願。
(aa3 po4 waa6 gin3 dou2 jyut6 gwong1, zau6 jiu3 faai3 di1 heoi2 jyun2.)
(Grandma says that when you see the moonlight, you have to quickly make a wish.)

小明諗咗諗，就對住個月亮講：「我希望聽日有炸雞髀食！」
(siu2 ming4 lam2 zo2 lam2, zau6 deoi3 zyu6 go3 jyut6 loeng6 gong2: "ngo5 hei1 mong6 ting1 jat6 jau5 zaa3 gai1 bei2 sik6!")
(Little Ming thought for a moment, then said to the moon, "I wish I could eat fried chicken legs tomorrow!")

點知第二日，真係有隻雞髀跌咗喺佢嘅窗口！
(dim2 zi1 dai2 ji6 jat6, zan1 hai6 jau5 zek3 gai1 bei2 dit3 zo2 hai2 keoi5 ge3 ceong1 hau2!)
(Unexpectedly, the next day, a chicken leg really fell onto his windowsill!)

原來係隔籬阿陳唔小心整跌咗，仲好好心請小明食埋。
(jyun4 lai4 hai6 gaak3 lei4 aa3 can4 m4 siu2 sam1 zeng2 dit3 zo2, zung1 hou2 hou2 sam1 ceng2 siu2 ming4 sik6 maai4.)
(It turned out that it was Uncle Chan next door who accidentally dropped it, and he kindly invited Little Ming to eat it too.)

小明知道，原來有時願望實現，唔一定係靠魔法㗎！
(siu2 ming4 zi1 dou3, jyun4 lai4 jau5 si4 jyun6 mong6 sat6 jin6, m4 jat1 ding6 hai6 kaau3 mo1 faat3 gaa3!)
(Little Ming realized that sometimes wishes come true, not necessarily through magic!)

瞓覺豬仔

阿婆今日去街市買餸，見到一隻瞓覺豬仔，好得意呀！
(aa3 po4 gam1 jat6 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 sung3, gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 fan3 gaau3 zyu1 zai2, hou2 dak1 ji3 aa3!)
(Grandma went to the market today to buy groceries and saw a sleeping piglet, so cute!)

佢瞓到四腳朝天，仲打埋鼻鼾添！
(keoi5 fan3 dou3 sei3 goek3 ciu4 tin1, zung6 daa2 maai4 bei6 hon1 tim1!)
(It was sleeping upside down, legs in the air, and even snoring!)

阿婆忍唔住笑咗出嚟，覺得佢好似自己個孫仔。
(aa3 po4 jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3 zo2 chut1 lai4, gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 ci5 zi6 gei2 go3 syun1 zai2.)
(Grandma couldn't help but laugh, thinking it looked like her own grandson.)

佢諗住買返屋企俾孫仔玩，點知豬仔醒咗，仲話肚餓要食嘢。
(keoi5 nam2 zyu6 maai5 faan1 uk1 kei2 bei2 syun1 zai2 waan2, dim2 zi1 zyu1 zai2 sing2 zo2, zung6 waa6 tou5 ngo6 jiu3 sik6 je5.)
(She thought about buying it home for her grandson to play with, but then the piglet woke up and said it was hungry.)

阿婆笑住買咗個包俾佢食，豬仔食得好開心呀！
(aa3 po4 siu3 zyu6 maai5 zo2 go3 baau1 bei2 keoi5 sik6, zyu1 zai2 sik6 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1 aa3!)
(Grandma smilingly bought a bun for it to eat, and the piglet ate it happily!)

薯仔先生嘅歷險

薯仔先生唔係一個普通嘅薯仔，佢有一個好得意嘅帽仔。
(syu2 zai2 sin1 saang1 m4 hai6 jat1 go3 pou2 tung1 ge3 syu2 zai2, keoi5 jau5 jat1 go3 hou2 dak1 ji3 ge3 mou2 zai2.)
(Mr. Potato wasn't an ordinary potato; he had a very cute little hat.)

佢日日都喺花園度探險，搵唔同嘅昆蟲做朋友。
(keoi5 jat1 jat6 dou1 hai2 faa1 jyun4 dou6 taam3 him2, wan2 m4 tung1 ge3 kwan1 cung4 zou6 pang4 jau5.)
(Every day, he explored in the garden, making friends with different insects.)

有一次，佢遇到一隻好怕醜嘅毛毛蟲，唔敢出嚟玩。
(jau5 jat1 ci3, keoi5 jyu6 dou2 jat1 zek3 hou2 paa3 cau2 ge3 mou4 mou4 cung4, m4 gam2 chut1 lai4 waan2.)
(One time, he met a very shy caterpillar who didn't dare to come out and play.)

薯仔先生就氹佢，話花園有好多靚嘢睇，唔使驚。
(syu2 zai2 sin1 saang1 zau6 tam5 keoi5, waa6 faa1 jyun4 jau5 hou2 do1 leng3 je5 tai2, m4 sai2 geng1.)
(Mr. Potato coaxed him, saying that the garden had many beautiful things to see and there was nothing to be afraid of.)

毛毛蟲終於鼓起勇氣，同薯仔先生一齊玩，發現原來花園真係好開心！
(mou4 mou4 cung4 zung1 jyu1 gu2 hei2 jung5 hei3, tung4 syu2 zai2 sin1 saang1 jat1 cai4 waan2, faat3 jin6 jyun4 lai4 faa1 jyun4 zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1!)
(The caterpillar finally plucked up his courage, played together with Mr. Potato, and discovered that the garden was really very happy!)

自此之後，毛毛蟲變成一隻好勇敢嘅蝴蝶，成日喺花園跳舞。
(zi6 ci2 zi1 hau6, mou4 mou4 cung4 bin3 sing4 jat1 zek3 hou2 yung5 gam2 ge3 wu4 dip6, sing4 jat6 hai2 faa1 jyun4 tiu3 mou5.)
(From then on, the caterpillar turned into a very brave butterfly, dancing in the garden every day.)

阿婆嘅機械貓

阿婆喺公園執到隻爛咗嘅遊戲機貓。
(aa3 po4 hai2 gung1 jyun2 zap1 dou2 zek3 laan6 zo2 ge3 jau4 hei3 gei1 maau1.)
(Grandma found a broken Game & Watch cat in the park.)

佢返到屋企，慢慢咁整返好佢。
(keoi5 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2, maan6 maan6 gam2 zing2 faan1 hou2 keoi5.)
(She went home and slowly fixed it.)

點知，隻貓識得講嘢，仲話自己叫「無先生」！
(dim2 zi1, zek3 maau1 sik1 dak1 gong2 je5, zung6 waa6 zi6 gei2 giu3 "mou4 sin1 saang1"!)
(Unexpectedly, the cat could talk, and said its name was "Mr. No"!)

無先生日日同阿婆去飲茶，幫佢霸位。
(mou4 sin1 saang1 jat1 jat1 tung4 aa3 po4 heoi3 jam2 chaa4, bong1 keoi5 baa3 wai2.)
(Mr. No went to dim sum with Grandma every day, helping her reserve a seat.)

有一日，無先生遇到隻叫「丹尼」嘅機械狗，佢哋一見鍾情。
(jau5 jat1 jat6, mou4 sin1 saang1 jyu6 dou2 zek3 giu3 "daan1 nei4" ge3 gei1 haai6 gau2, keoi5 dei6 jat1 gin3 zung1 ching4.)
(One day, Mr. No met a mechanical dog named "Danny," and they fell in love at first sight.)

佢哋決定一齊環遊世界，用阿婆嘅輪椅做車！
(keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 jat1 cai4 waan4 jau4 sai3 gaai3, yung6 aa3 po4 ge3 leon4 ji2 zou6 che1!)
(They decided to travel the world together, using Grandma's wheelchair as a car!)

storyName: 遊戲機先生同茶餐廳阿姐
storyBody:
遊戲機先生同茶餐廳阿姐

遊戲機先生今日又嚟茶餐廳食早餐啦。
(jau4 hei3 gei1 sin1 saang1 gam1 jat6 jau6 lai4 caa4 caan1 teng1 sik6 zou2 caan1 laa3.)
(Mr. Game & Watch came to the Cha Chaan Teng again today for breakfast.)

佢照舊叫咗個沙嗲牛肉麵同熱奶茶。
(keoi5 ziu3 gau6 giu3 zo2 go3 saa1 de1 ngau4 juk6 min6 tung4 jit6 naai5 caa4.)
(He ordered the usual satay beef noodles and hot milk tea.)

阿姐丹妮見到佢，笑瞇瞇咁講：「早晨呀，遊戲機先生！」
(aa3 ze1 daan1 nei4 gin3 dou2 keoi5, siu3 mei1 mei1 gam2 gong2: "zou2 san4 aa3, jau4 hei3 gei1 sin1 saang1!")
(Danae, the waitress, saw him and said with a smile, "Good morning, Mr. Game & Watch!")

遊戲機先生都笑住應佢：「早晨，丹妮！今日都咁精神！」
(jau4 hei3 gei1 sin1 saang1 dou1 siu3 zyu6 jing3 keoi5: "zou2 san4, daan1 nei4! gam1 jat6 dou1 gam3 zing1 san4!")
(Mr. Game & Watch replied with a smile, "Good morning, Danae! You're looking so energetic today!")

丹妮話：「梗係啦！見到你嚟，成個人都醒神晒！」
(daan1 nei4 waa6: "gang2 hai6 laa1! gin3 dou2 nei5 lai4, sing4 go3 jan4 dou1 sing2 san4 saai3!")
(Danae said, "Of course! Seeing you come in, my whole being perks up!")

遊戲機先生聽完，塊面紅紅地，即刻低頭食麵。
(jau4 hei3 gei1 sin1 saang1 ting1 jyun4, faai3 min6 hung4 hung4 dei2, zik1 hak1 dai1 tau4 sik6 min6.)
(Mr. Game & Watch, after hearing that, blushed and immediately lowered his head to eat his noodles.)

捉迷藏嘅秘密

阿伯Game & Watch成日偷偷地望住阿Danay。
(aa3 baak3 Game & Watch seng4 jat6 tau1 tau1 dei6 mong5 zyu6 aa3 Danay.)
(Mr. Game & Watch always secretly watched Danay.)

有一日，佢鼓起勇氣，遞咗個手作仔嘅迷你Game & Watch俾佢。
(jau5 jat1 jat6, keoi5 gu2 hei2 yung5 hei3, dai6 zo2 go3 sau2 zok3 zai2 ge3 mini Game & Watch bei2 keoi5.)
(One day, he plucked up the courage and handed her a handmade mini Game & Watch.)

阿Danay笑咪咪咁接過，話：「嘩，好得意呀！」
(aa3 Danay siu3 mi1 mi1 gam2 zip3 gwo3, waa6: "waa1, hou2 dak1 ji3 aa3!")
(Danay smiled brightly as she took it, saying, "Wow, how cute!")

佢哋開始一齊玩捉迷藏，阿伯永遠都匿埋喺棵大樹後面。
(keoi5 dei6 hoi1 ci2 jat1 cai4 waan2 zuk1 mai4 cong4, aa3 baak3 wing5 jyun5 dou1 nik1 maai4 hai2 fo2 daai6 syu3 hau6 min6.)
(They started playing hide-and-seek together, and Mr. Game & Watch always hid behind the big tree.)

阿Danay每次都扮搵唔到，但係其實佢一早已經見到阿伯嘅黑影啦！
(aa3 Danay mui5 ci3 dou1 baan3 wan2 m4 dou2, daan6 hai6 kei4 sat6 keoi5 jat1 zou2 ji5 ging1 gin3 dou2 aa3 baak3 ge3 hak1 ying2 laa1!)
(Danay would always pretend she couldn't find him, but actually, she had already seen Mr. Game & Watch's shadow!)

佢哋嘅笑聲，充滿咗成個公園，溫馨又甜蜜。
(keoi5 dei6 ge3 siu3 seng1, cung1 mun5 zo2 seng4 go3 gung1 jyun2, wan1 hing1 jau6 tim4 mat6.)
(Their laughter filled the entire park, warm and sweet.)

storyName: 跳跳人阿伯同埋菲利仔
storyBody:
跳跳人阿伯同埋菲利仔

阿伯跳跳人成日喺公園度跳嚟跳去，啲細路仔都覺得佢好得意。
(aa3 bak1 tiu3 tiu3 jan4 sing4 jat6 hai2 gung1 jyun2 dou6 tiu3 lai4 tiu3 heoi3, di1 sai3 lou2 zai2 dou1 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 dak1 ji3.)
(Mr. Game & Watch always hops around in the park, and the kids all think he's very cute.)

有一日，菲利仔見到阿伯唔小心跌咗落地，即刻衝過去扶佢起身。
(jau5 jat1 jat6, fei1 lei6 zai2 gin3 dou2 aa3 bak1 m4 siu2 sam1 dit3 zo2 lok6 dei6, zik1 hak1 cung1 gwo3 heoi3 fu4 keoi5 hei2 san1.)
(One day, Danaey saw Mr. Game & Watch accidentally fall to the ground and immediately rushed over to help him up.)

阿伯笑眯眯咁話：「多謝你呀，好心嘅小朋友。」
(aa3 bak1 siu3 mei1 mei1 gam2 waa6: "do1 ze6 nei5 aa3, hou2 sam1 ge3 siu2 peng4 jau5.")
(Mr. Game & Watch smiled and said, "Thank you, kind child.")

菲利仔話：「唔使客氣，幫人係應該嘅！」
(fei1 lei6 zai2 waa6: "m4 sai2 hak3 hei3, bong1 jan4 hai6 jing1 goi1 ge3!")
(Danaey said, "You're welcome, helping people is the right thing to do!")

之後，阿伯送咗個跳跳糖俾菲利仔，兩個人都笑得好開心。
(zi1 hau6, aa3 bak1 sung3 zo2 go3 tiu3 tiu3 tong2 bei2 fei1 lei6 zai2, loeng5 go3 jan4 dou1 siu3 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.)
(After that, Mr. Game & Watch gave Danaey a popping candy, and both of them smiled very happily.)

小貓咪嘅秘密花園

小花貓阿妹最鍾意喺屋企後花園玩。
(siu2 faa1 maau1 aa3 mui1 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 hai2 uk1 kei2 hau6 faa1 jyun4 waan2.)
(Little kitten Ah Mui loves to play in the backyard garden.)

有一日，佢發現咗一棵識得唱歌嘅花。
(jau5 jat1 jat6, keoi5 faat3 hin1 zo2 jat1 fo2 sik1 dak1 coeng3 go1 ge3 faa1.)
(One day, she discovered a flower that could sing.)

朵花嘅歌聲甜美，好似蜜糖咁。
(do2 faa1 ge3 go1 sing1 tim4 mei5, hou2 ci5 mat6 tong4 gam3.)
(The flower's singing voice was sweet, like honey.)

阿妹日日都去聽佢唱歌，仲同佢傾偈添！
(aa3 mui1 jat6 jat6 dou1 heoi3 teng1 keoi5 coeng3 go1, zung1 tung4 keoi5 king1 gai2 tim1!)
(Ah Mui went to listen to it sing every day and even chatted with it!)

原來朵花係花園嘅守護神嚟㗎！
(jyun4 loi4 do2 faa1 hai6 faa1 jyun4 ge3 sau2 wu6 san4 lai4 gaa3!)
(It turned out that the flower was the guardian of the garden!)

小貓咪嘅秘密花園

隻小貓咪阿妹，佢有個秘密花園。
(zek3 siu2 maau1 mi1 aa3 mui1, keoi5 jau5 go3 bei3 mat6 faa1 jyun4.)
(The little cat, Ah Mui, has a secret garden.)

花園入面種滿曬唔同顏色嘅波波。
(faa1 jyun4 jap6 min6 zung2 mun5 saai3 m4 tung4 ngaan4 sik1 ge3 bo1 bo1.)
(Inside the garden are planted different colored balls.)

每日佢都會喺度同啲波波傾偈，講佢嘅心事。
(mui5 jat6 keoi5 dou1 wui5 hai2 dou6 tung4 di1 bo1 bo1 king1 gai2, gong2 keoi5 ge3 sam1 si6.)
(Every day she would chat with the balls, telling them her secrets.)

有一日，阿妹發現啲波波識得發光，仲可以同佢講嘢！
(jau5 jat1 jat6, aa3 mui1 faat3 jin6 di1 bo1 bo1 sik1 dak1 faat3 gwong1, zung6 ho2 ji5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 je5!)
(One day, Ah Mui discovered that the balls could glow and even talk to her!)

原來啲波波係啲星星跌落嚟嘅，佢哋想搵返屋企。
(jyun4 loi4 di1 bo1 bo1 hai6 di1 sing1 sing1 dit3 lok6 lai4 ge3, keoi5 dei6 soeng2 wan2 faan1 uk1 kei2.)
(It turned out the balls were stars that had fallen down, and they wanted to find their way home.)

阿妹就決定幫佢哋，一齊搭火箭上太空！
(aa3 mui1 zau6 kyut3 ding6 bong1 keoi5 dei6, jat1 cai4 daap3 fo2 zin3 soeng5 taai3 hung1!)
(Ah Mui decided to help them, and they boarded a rocket to space together!)

storyName: 阿 Fritz 嘅秘密花園
storyBody:
阿 Fritz 嘅秘密花園

阿 Fritz 今日偷偷雞走到公園後面。
(aa3 Fritz gam1 jat6 tau1 tau1 gai1 zau2 dou3 gung1 jyun2 hau6 min6.)
(Today, Fritz sneakily ran to the back of the park.)

佢發現咗一個好靚嘅秘密花園，開滿晒五顏六色嘅花。
(keoi5 faat3 hin3 zo2 jat1 go3 hou2 leng3 ge3 bei3 mat6 faa1 jyun4, hoi1 mun5 saai3 ng5 ngaan4 luk6 sik1 ge3 faa1.)
(He discovered a beautiful secret garden filled with colorful flowers.)

突然，一隻識講嘢嘅蝴蝶飛埋嚟，話呢個花園係屬於有童真嘅小朋友。
(dat6 jin4, jat1 zek3 sik1 gong2 je5 ge3 wu4 dip6 fei1 maai4 lei4, waa6 ni1 go3 faa1 jyun4 hai6 suk6 jyu1 jau5 tung4 zan1 ge3 siu2 pang4 jau5.)
(Suddenly, a talking butterfly flew over and said this garden belongs to children with childlike innocence.)

阿 Fritz 開心到跳起，原來保持童心先可以搵到最靚嘅嘢。
(aa3 Fritz hoi1 sam1 dou3 tiu3 hei2, jyun4 loi4 bou2 ci4 tung4 sam1 sin1 ho2 ji5 wan2 dou3 zeoi3 leng3 ge3 je5.)
(Fritz was so happy he jumped up, realizing that keeping a childlike heart is the only way to find the most beautiful things.)

佢決定每日都嚟花園探吓班花花草草，分享佢嘅快樂。
(keoi5 kyut3 ding6 mui5 jat6 dou1 lei4 faa1 jyun4 taam3 haa5 baan1 faa1 faa1 cou2 cou2, fan1 hoeng2 keoi5 ge3 faai3 lok6.)
(He decided to come to the garden every day to visit the flowers and plants, sharing his happiness.)

放風箏嘅秘密

阿輝今日攞住隻風箏去公園。
(a3 fai1 gam1 jat6 lo2 zyu6 zek3 fung1 zang1 heoi3 gung1 jyun2.)
(Ah Fai took a kite to the park today.)

點知佢唔記得帶線，好掃興呀。
(dim2 zi1 keoi5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 sin3, hou2 sou3 hing3 aa3.)
(Turns out he forgot to bring the string, what a disappointment!)

突然，一隻雀仔飛埋嚟，話可以幫手。
(dat6 jin4, jat1 zek3 zoek3 zai2 fei1 maai4 lai4, waa6 ho2 ji5 bong1 sau2.)
(Suddenly, a bird flew over and said it could help.)

雀仔用佢嘅羽毛做風箏線，真係估佢唔到！
(zoek3 zai2 jung6 keoi5 ge3 jyu5 mou4 zou6 fung1 zang1 sin3, zan1 hai6 gu2 keoi5 m4 dou3!)
(The bird used its feathers as kite string, who would have guessed!)

阿輝同雀仔一齊放風箏，玩得好開心。
(a3 fai1 tung4 zoek3 zai2 jat1 cai4 fong3 fung1 zang1, waan2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.)
(Ah Fui and the bird flew the kite together and had a lot of fun.)

黃昏時，雀仔話要返屋企，阿輝多謝佢嘅幫忙。
(wong4 fan1 si4, zoek3 zai2 waa6 jiu3 faan1 uk1 kei2, a3 fai1 do1 ze6 keoi5 ge3 bong1 mong4.)
(At dusk, the bird said it had to go home, and Ah Fai thanked it for its help.)

阿輝學識咗，有時朋友嘅幫助，就喺最意想不到嘅地方出現。
(a3 fai1 hok6 sik1 zo2, jau5 si4 pang4 jau5 ge3 bong1 zo6, zau6 hai2 zeoi3 ji3 seong2 bat1 dou3 ge3 dei6 fong1 ceot1 jin6.)
(Ah Fui learned that sometimes a friend's help appears in the most unexpected places.)

storyName: 阿 Fritz 嘅 秘密花園
storyBody:
阿 Fritz 嘅 秘密花園

阿 Fritz 鍾意喺公園捉精靈，日日都去。
(aa3 Fritz zung1 ji3 hai2 gung1 jyun2 zuk1 zing1 ling4, jat1 jat1 dou1 heoi3.)
(Fritz loves catching Pokémon in the park and goes every day.)

有日佢發現咗一幅好舊嘅牆，牆邊有個窿仔。
(jau5 jat1 jat6 keoi5 faat3 hin3 zo2 jat1 fuk1 hou2 gau6 ge3 coeng4, coeng4 bin1 jau5 go3 lung1 zai2.)
(One day, he discovered a very old wall with a small hole beside it.)

Fritz 好奇咁望入去，嘩！ 裏面竟然係個秘密花園！
(Fritz hou2 kei4 gam2 mong6 jap6 heoi3, waa1! leoi5 min6 ging2 jin4 hai6 go3 bei3 mat6 faa1 jyun4!)
(Fritz curiously looked inside, wow! It was actually a secret garden inside!)

花園裏面開滿晒唔同顏色嘅花，仲有好多雀仔唱歌。
(faa1 jyun2 leoi5 min6 hoi1 mun5 saai3 m4 tung4 ngaan4 sik1 ge3 faa1, zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 zoek3 zai2 coeng3 go1.)
(The garden was full of flowers of different colors, and many birds were singing.)

佢決定每日嚟呢度同啲花花草草講嘢，呢個就變成佢最鍾意嘅地方。
(keoi5 kyut3 ding6 mui5 jat6 lai4 ni1 dou6 tung4 di1 faa1 faa1 cou2 cou2 gong2 je5, ni1 go3 zau6 bin3 sing4 keoi5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 dei6 fong1.)
(He decided to come here every day to talk to the flowers and plants, and this became his favorite place.)

小貓嘅秘密花園

阿婆嘅後花園入面，住咗一隻細細粒嘅三色貓。
(aa3 po4 ge3 hau6 faa1 jyun4 jap6 min6, zyu6 zo2 jat1 zek3 sai3 sai3 lap1 ge3 saam1 sik1 maau1.)
(In Grandma's backyard garden, lived a tiny calico cat.)

佢最鍾意匿埋喺啲玫瑰花叢裏面，偷偷哋瞓晏覺。
(keoi5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 nik1 maai4 hai2 di1 mui4 gwai3 faa1 cung4 leoi5 min6, tau1 tau1 dei2 fan3 aan3 gaau3.)
(She loved to hide amongst the rose bushes, secretly taking afternoon naps.)

有一日，佢發現咗一朵識得發光嘅七彩菇。
(jau5 jat1 jat6, keoi5 faat3 hin3 zo2 jat1 doe2 sik1 dak1 faat3 gwong1 ge3 cat1 coi2 gu1.)
(One day, she discovered a colorful mushroom that could glow.)

原來呢朵菇係精靈嘅秘密燈籠，照亮成個花園。
(jyun4 lai4 ni1 doe2 gu1 hai6 zing1 ling4 ge3 bei3 mat6 dang1 lung4, ziu3 loeng6 seng4 go3 faa1 jyun4.)
(It turned out that this mushroom was the fairies' secret lantern, illuminating the whole garden.)

阿婆見到花園咁靚，笑到見牙唔見眼，仲話要多謝隻貓貓。
(aa3 po4 gin3 dou2 faa1 jyun4 gam3 leng3, siu3 dou3 gin3 ngaa4 m4 gin3 ngaan5, zung1 waa6 jiu3 do1 ze6 zek3 maau1 maau1.)
(Grandma saw how beautiful the garden was, smiled so widely her eyes disappeared, and even said she had to thank the kitty.)

遊樂場奇遇

阿婆喺公園度賣緊棉花糖，啲棉花糖大嚿到好似雲咁。
(aa3 po4 hai2 gung1 yun2 dou6 maai6 gan2 min4 faa1 tong2, di1 min4 faa1 tong2 daai6 gau6 dou3 hou2 ci5 wan4 gam3.)
(Grandma was selling cotton candy in the park, and the cotton candy was as big as clouds.)

有個細路哥見到，眼都發晒光，即刻跑埋去買。
(jau5 go3 sai3 lou6 go1 gin3 dou2, ngaan5 dou1 faat3 saai3 gwong1, zik1 hak1 paau2 maai4 heoi3 maai5.)
(A child saw it, his eyes lit up, and he immediately ran over to buy one.)

阿婆笑眯眯咁遞咗一嚿彩虹色嘅棉花糖俾佢。
(aa3 po4 siu3 mei1 mei1 gam2 dai6 zo2 jat1 gau6 coi2 hung4 sik1 ge3 min4 faa1 tong2 bei2 keoi5.)
(Grandma smiled and handed him a rainbow-colored cotton candy.)

個細路哥咬咗一啖，嘩，甜到好似飲咗成樽蜜糖咁！
(go3 sai3 lou6 go1 ngaau5 zo2 jat1 daam6, waa1, tim4 dou3 hou2 ci5 jam2 zo2 seng4 zeon1 mat6 tong4 gam2!)
(The child took a bite, wow, it was as sweet as drinking a whole bottle of honey!)

食食下，棉花糖竟然變咗一隻識飛嘅獨角獸，仲帶埋個細路哥喺公園上面飛！
(sik6 sik6 haa5, min4 faa1 tong2 ging2 jin4 bin3 zo2 jat1 zek3 sik1 fei1 ge3 duk6 gok3 sau3, zung1 daai3 maai4 go3 sai3 lou6 go1 hai2 gung1 yun2 soeng6 min6 fei1!)
(While eating, the cotton candy actually turned into a flying unicorn and even took the child flying over the park!)

神奇嘅檸檬茶

阿輝今日喺街市買咗好多新鮮檸檬。
(a3 fai1 gam1 jat6 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 sin1 ning4 mung1.)
(Ah Fai bought a lot of fresh lemons at the market today.)

佢諗住整啲冰凍檸檬茶嚟消暑。
(keoi5 nam2 zyu6 zing2 di1 bing1 dung3 ning4 mung1 caa4 lai4 siu1 syu2.)
(He planned to make some iced lemon tea to beat the summer heat.)

點知佢一唔小心，將啲檸檬汁滴咗落佢嘅 Fritz 隻狗仔度。
(dim2 zi1 keoi5 jat1 m4 siu2 sam1, zoeng1 di1 ning4 mung1 zap1 dik1 zo2 lok6 keoi5 ge3 Fritz zek3 gau2 zai2 dou6.)
(Unexpectedly, he accidentally dripped some lemon juice on his dog, Fritz.)

Fritz 平時好怕水，但係今次佢竟然好享受，仲舔埋啲檸檬汁。
(Fritz ping4 si4 hou2 paa3 seoi2, daan6 hai6 gam1 ci3 keoi5 ging2 jin4 hou2 hoeng2 sau6, zung1 tim2 maai4 di1 ning4 mung1 zap1.)
(Fritz is usually very afraid of water, but this time he surprisingly enjoyed it and even licked up the lemon juice.)

阿輝見到都忍唔住笑出聲，原來 Fritz 鍾意檸檬茶味㗎！
(a3 fai1 gin3 dou2 dou1 jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3 chut1 seng1, jyun4 lai4 Fritz zung1 ji3 ning4 mung1 caa4 mei6 gaa3!)
(Ah Fai couldn't help but laugh when he saw this; it turned out Fritz liked the lemon tea flavour!)

神奇嘅士多啤梨雲
(San4 kei4 ge3 si3 to2 be1 lei4 wan4)
(The Magical Strawberry Cloud)

阿 Fritz Dandy 今日諗住去公園野餐，帶咗佢至愛嘅士多啤梨三文治。
(aa3 Fritz Dandy gam1 jat6 nam2 zyu6 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 je5 caan1, daai3 zo2 keoi5 zi3 oi3 ge3 si3 to2 be1 lei4 saam1 man4 zi6.)
(Today, Fritz Dandy decided to go for a picnic in the park, bringing his favourite strawberry sandwiches.)

點知行到半路，天上面出現咗一嚿好大好大嘅士多啤梨雲！
(dim2 zi1 haang4 dou3 bun3 lou6, tin1 soeng6 min6 ceot1 hin1 zo2 jat1 gau6 hou2 daai6 hou2 daai6 ge3 si3 to2 be1 lei4 wan4!)
(But halfway there, a huge, huge strawberry cloud appeared in the sky!)

Fritz Dandy 好興奮，佢覺得好似發緊夢咁！
(Fritz Dandy hou2 hing1 fan5, keoi5 gok3 dak1 hou2 ci5 faat3 gan2 mung6 gam2!)
(Fritz Dandy was so excited, he felt like he was dreaming!)

佢伸出手，想摸下嚿雲，點知真係摸到，仲有士多啤梨嘅香味添！
(keoi5 san1 ceot1 sau2, soeng2 mo2 haa5 gau6 wan4, dim2 zi1 zan1 hai6 mo2 dou2, zung1 jau5 si3 to2 be1 lei4 ge3 hoeng1 mei6 tim1!)
(He reached out his hand, wanting to touch the cloud, and he really did touch it, and it even smelled like strawberries!)

原來係士多啤梨仙子送俾佢嘅禮物，因為佢咁鍾意士多啤梨！
(jyun4 loi4 hai6 si3 to2 be1 lei4 sin1 zi2 sung3 bei2 keoi5 ge3 lai5 mat6, jan1 wai6 keoi5 gam3 zung1 ji3 si3 to2 be1 lei4!)
(It turned out to be a gift from the Strawberry Fairy, because he loved strawberries so much!)

Fritz Dandy 開心到跳起舞，一路食住士多啤梨三文治，一路望住嚿神奇嘅士多啤梨雲！
(Fritz Dandy hoi1 sam1 dou3 tiu3 hei2 mou5, jat1 lou6 sik6 zyu6 si3 to2 be1 lei4 saam1 man4 zi6, jat1 lou6 mong6 zyu6 gau6 san4 kei4 ge3 si3 to2 be1 lei4 wan4!)
(Fritz Dandy was so happy he danced, eating his strawberry sandwich while looking at the magical strawberry cloud!)

失咗嘅風箏

細蚊仔阿輝喺公園度放風箏，玩得好開心。
(sai3 man1 zai2 aa3 fai1 hai2 gung1 yun2 dou6 fong3 fung1 zeng1, waan2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.)
(Little Ah Fai was flying a kite in the park, having a great time.)

點知一陣怪風吹嚟，將佢個風箏吹斷咗線。
(dim2 zi1 jat1 zan6 gwaai3 fung1 cheui1 lei4, jeung1 keui5 go3 fung1 zeng1 cheui1 tyun5 zo2 sin3.)
(Suddenly, a gust of strange wind came and snapped the kite's string.)

阿輝好唔開心，眼淚都差啲流出嚟。
(aa3 fai1 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1, ngaan5 leoi6 dou1 chaa1 di1 lau4 chut1 lei4.)
(Ah Fai was very sad, and tears almost welled up in his eyes.)

突然，有個着住花碌碌衫嘅叔叔行埋嚟，佢係 Fritz Dandy。
(dat6 jin4, jau5 go3 zoek3 jyu6 faa1 luk1 luk1 saam1 ge3 suk1 suk1 haang4 maai4 lei4, keui5 hai6 Fritz Dandy.)
(Suddenly, an uncle wearing brightly colored clothes walked over; it was Fritz Dandy.)

Fritz Dandy 笑咪咪噉變咗個新嘅風箏畀阿輝，仲靚過之前嗰個！
(Fritz Dandy siu3 mi1 mi1 gam2 bin3 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 fung1 zeng1 bei2 aa3 fai1, zung6 leng3 gwo3 zi1 chin4 go2 go3!)
(Fritz Dandy smiled and magically produced a new kite for Ah Fai, even more beautiful than the previous one!)

阿輝破涕為笑，同 Fritz Dandy 一齊放風箏，公園充滿咗歡樂嘅笑聲。
(aa3 fai1 po3 tai3 wai4 siu3, tung4 Fritz Dandy jat1 chai4 fong3 fung1 zeng1, gung1 yun2 chung1 mun5 zo2 fun1 lok6 ge3 siu3 seng1.)
(Ah Fai stopped crying and started laughing, flying kites with Fritz Dandy, filling the park with joyful laughter.)

遊樂場的秘密

小明喺公園玩緊，突然見到一隻識講嘢嘅雀仔。
(siu2 ming4 hai2 gung1 jyun2 waan2 gan2, dat6 jin4 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 sik1 gong2 je5 ge3 zoek3 zai2.)
(Little Ming was playing in the park when he suddenly saw a talking bird.)

隻雀仔話佢係遊樂場嘅守護神，叫做Urenu。
(zek3 zoek3 zai2 waa6 keoi5 hai6 jau4 lok6 coeng4 ge3 sau2 wu6 san4, giu3 zou6 Urenu.)
(The bird said it was the guardian of the playground, called Urenu.)

Urenu 請小明幫手搵返唔見咗嘅魔法羽毛。
(Urenu ceng2 siu2 ming4 bong1 sau2 wan2 faan1 m4 gin3 zo2 ge3 mo1 faat3 jyu5 mou4.)
(Urenu asked Little Ming to help find its missing magical feather.)

佢哋一齊喺滑梯底，沙池入面搵，都搵唔到。
(keoi5 dei6 jat1 cai4 hai2 waat6 tai1 dai2, saa1 ci4 jap6 min6 wan2, dou1 wan2 m4 dou2.)
(Together they searched under the slide and in the sandpit, but couldn't find it.)

點知，原來條羽毛就黐咗喺小明嘅背脊上面！
(dim2 zi1, jyun4 loi4 tiu4 jyu5 mou4 zau6 ci1 zo2 hai2 siu2 ming4 ge3 bui3 zek3 soeng6 min6!)
(Unexpectedly, the feather was stuck on Little Ming's back!)

Urenu 好開心，送咗粒幸運糖俾小明。
(Urenu hou2 hoi1 sam1, sung3 zo2 lap1 hang6 wan6 tong2 bei2 siu2 ming4.)
(Urenu was very happy and gave Little Ming a lucky candy.)

小明食咗粒糖，覺得今日特別開心。
(siu2 ming4 sik6 zo2 lap1 tong2, gok3 dak1 gam1 jat6 dak6 bit3 hoi1 sam1.)
(Little Ming ate the candy and felt especially happy today.)

烏蠅頭嘅秘密

烏蠅頭阿婆成日戴住頂大紅帽。
(wu1 ying1 tau4 aa3 po4 sing4 jat6 daai3 zoek6 ding2 daai6 hung4 mou2.)
(Grandma Urenu Toon always wears a big red hat.)

細路仔都好好奇，想知帽下面有乜嘢。
(sai3 lou6 zai2 dou1 hou2 hou2 kei4, seung2 ji1 mou2 haa6 min6 jau5 mat1 je5.)
(The children were very curious and wanted to know what was under the hat.)

有一日，大風吹走咗阿婆頂帽！
(jau5 jat1 jat6, daai6 fung1 chui1 zau2 zo2 aa3 po4 ding2 mou2!)
(One day, a strong wind blew Grandma's hat away!)

嘩！原來阿婆個頭係一棵開滿晒花嘅樹！
(waa1! jyun4 loi4 aa3 po4 go3 tau4 hai6 jat1 go3 hoi1 mun5 saai3 faa1 ge3 syu6!)
(Wow! It turned out that Grandma's head was a tree full of flowers!)

啲細路仔拍晒手掌，覺得好靚呀！
(di1 sai3 lou6 zai2 paak3 saai3 sau2 zoeng2, gok3 dak1 hou2 leng3 aa3!)
(The children clapped their hands, thinking it was so beautiful!)

阿婆嘅秘密花園

阿婆喺後花園種咗好多奇奇怪怪嘅花。
(aa3 po4 hai2 hau6 faa1 jyun4 zung3 zo2 hou2 do1 kei4 kei4 gwaai3 gwaai3 ge3 faa1.)
(Grandma planted many strange and peculiar flowers in her backyard garden.)

啲花識得唱歌跳舞，好得意㗎！
(di1 faa1 sik1 dak1 coeng3 go1 tiu3 mou5, hou2 dak1 ji3 gaa3!)
(The flowers can sing and dance, they're very cute!)

有日，我發現其中一朵花識得講嘢！
(jau5 jat1 jat6, ngo5 faat3 jin6 kei4 zung1 jat1 do2 faa1 sik1 dak1 gong2 je5!)
(One day, I discovered that one of the flowers could talk!)

佢話阿婆其實係花仙子嚟㗎。
(keoi5 waa6 aa3 po4 kei4 sat6 hai6 faa1 sin1 zi2 lei4 gaa3.)
(It said that Grandma is actually a flower fairy.)

阿婆笑笑口，話係秘密嚟㗎，唔好話俾人知啊！
(aa3 po4 siu3 siu3 hau2, waa6 hai6 bei3 mat6 lei4 gaa3, m4 hou2 waa6 bei2 jan4 zi1 aa3!)
(Grandma smiled and said it was a secret and not to tell anyone!)

得意嘅雲吞麵

阿輝今日諗住去茶餐廳食碗雲吞麵。
(aa3 fai1 gam1 jat6 lam2 zyu6 heoi3 caa4 caan1 teng1 sik6 wun2 wan4 tan1 min6.)
(Ah Fai decided to go to the cha chaan teng to eat a bowl of wonton noodles today.)

點知佢一入去，見到隻貓企喺收銀機上面。
(dim2 zi1 keoi5 jat1 jap6 heoi3, gin3 dou2 zek3 maau1 kei5 hai2 sau1 ngan2 gei1 soeng6 min6.)
(But as soon as he went in, he saw a cat standing on top of the cash register.)

隻貓仲好得意咁同佢講：「歡迎光臨，想食啲咩啊？」
(zek3 maau1 zung6 hou2 dak1 ji3 gam2 tung4 keoi5 gong2: "fun1 jing4 gwong1 lam4, soeng2 sik6 di1 me1 aa3?")
(The cat even said to him in a very cute way: "Welcome, what would you like to eat?")

阿輝嚇咗一跳，但係忍唔住笑咗出嚟。
(aa3 fai1 haak3 zo2 jat1 tiu3, daan6 hai6 jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3 zo2 chut1 lai4.)
(Ah Fai was startled, but couldn't help but laugh.)

最後，佢叫咗碗特別大嘅雲吞麵，隻貓仲送咗佢杯凍檸茶。
(zeoi3 hau6, keoi5 giu3 zo2 wun2 dak6 bit6 daai6 ge3 wan4 tan1 min6, zek3 maau1 zung6 sung3 zo2 keoi5 bui1 dung3 ning2 caa4.)
(In the end, he ordered a particularly large bowl of wonton noodles, and the cat even gave him a complimentary iced lemon tea.)

放學後嘅奇遇

放學後嘅奇遇

點知行到花園中間，見到一班螞蟻喺度開緊舞會，佢哋仲邀請阿輝一齊跳舞。
(dim2 ji1 haang4 dou3 faa1 jyun2 jung1 gaan1, gin3 dou3 jat1 baan1 maa5 ngai5 hai2 dou6 hoi1 gan2 mou5 wui2, keoi5 dei6 jung2 chieng2 aa3 fai1 jat1 chai4 tiu3 mou5.)

阿輝覺得好開心，就放低士的，同啲螞蟻跳咗成晚嘅 cha cha。
(aa3 fai1 gok3 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1, jau6 fong3 dai1 si6 dik1, tung4 di1 maa5 ngai5 tiu3 zo2 seng4 maan1 ge3 cha cha.)
(Ah Fai felt very happy, so he put down his walking stick and danced the cha cha with the ants all night.)

最後，佢先發現原來唱歌嘅草莓只係一個美麗嘅夢，但係同螞蟻跳舞嘅回憶更加珍貴。
(jui3 hau6, keoi5 sin1 faat3 jin6 jyun4 loi4 cheung3 go1 ge3 chou2 mui2 ji2 hai6 jat1 go3 mei5 lai6 ge3 mung6, daan6 hai6 tung4 maa5 ngai5 tiu3 mou5 ge3 wui4 jik1 gang3 gaa1 chan1 gwai3.)

瞓覺豬嘅夢想

點知，原來係隔離屋阿婆煮緊咖喱雞，唔係魚蛋呀！
(dim2 zi1, jyun4 loi4 hai6 gaak3 lei4 uk1 aa3 po4 zyu2 gan2 gaa3 le1 gai1, m4 hai6 jyu2 daan2 aa3!)

阿花醒咗之後，覺得又好笑又失望，但係都決定起身去買魚蛋食。

細路女嘅月亮旅行

玩到攰，月亮火箭送小雲返屋企，佢醒返嘅時候，發現自己瞓喺自己張床上面，好似發咗個好靚嘅夢咁。
(waan2 dou3 gui6, jyut6 loeng4 fo2 zin3 sung3 siu2 wan4 faan1 uk1 kei2, keoi5 seng2 faan1 ge3 si4 hau6, faat3 jin6 zi6 gei2 fan3 hai2 zi6 gei2 zoeng1 cong4 soeng6 min6, hou2 ci5 faat3 zo2 go3 hou2 leng3 ge3 mung6 gam2.)
(When she was tired from playing, the moon rocket took Siu Wan back home, when she woke up, she realised she was sleeping on her own bed, as if she had a very beautiful dream.)

你好月餅

阿婆今朝起身，見到個月餅識講嘢，嚇咗一跳。

(dim2 zi1, aa3 po4 jat1 ngaau5 lok6 heoi3, go3 go3 jyut6 beng2 zau6 bin3 faan1 pou2 tung1 jyut6 beng2, mat1 je5 dou1 mou5 faat3 sang1 gwo3 gam2.)

(aa3 po4 nam2, ho2 nang4 hai6 zi6 gei2 ngaan5 faa1 ze1.)

阿婆嘅秘密花園
