(Siu Ming was so startled he jumped, so Grandma really does know how to chat with the flowers!)

佢決定以後都要幫阿婆淋花，等啲花開心啲。
(keoi5 kyut3 ding6 ji5 hau6 dou1 jiu3 bong1 aa3 po4 lam4 faa1, dang2 di1 faa1 hoi1 sam1 di1.)
(He decided that in the future, he would help Grandma water the flowers, so that the flowers would be happier.)

秘密花園

阿婆喺公園種咗個秘密花園，淨係佢自己知。
(aa3 po4 hai2 gung1 jyun2 zung3 zo2 go3 bei3 mat6 faa1 jyun4, zing6 hai6 keoi5 zi6 gei2 zi1.)
(Grandma planted a secret garden in the park, known only to herself.)

花園入面種咗好多唔同顏色嘅花，靚到不得了。
(faa1 jyun2 jap6 min6 zung3 zo2 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ngaan4 sik1 ge3 faa1, leng3 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5.)
(Inside the garden, she planted many different colored flowers, beautiful beyond compare.)

有一日，有個細路仔發現咗阿婆嘅秘密花園。
(jau5 jat1 jat6, jau5 go3 sai3 lou6 zai2 faat3 hin1 zo2 aa3 po4 ge3 bei3 mat6 faa1 jyun4.)
(One day, a little kid discovered Grandma's secret garden.)

阿婆見到細路仔咁鍾意啲花，就送咗一紥俾佢。
(aa3 po4 gin3 dou2 sai3 lou6 zai2 gam3 zung1 ji3 di1 faa1, zau6 sung3 zo2 jat1 zaat3 bei2 keoi5.)
(Grandma saw how much the kid liked the flowers, so she gave him a bouquet.)

細路仔好開心，每日都嚟幫阿婆淋花。
(sai3 lou6 zai2 hou2 hoi1 sam1, mui5 jat6 dou1 lai4 bong1 aa3 po4 lam4 faa1.)
(The little kid was very happy and came to help Grandma water the flowers every day.)

秘密花園唔再係秘密，而係變成咗佢哋兩個嘅共同回憶。
(bei3 mat6 faa1 jyun4 m4 zoi3 hai6 bei3 mat6, ji4 hai6 bin3 sing4 zo2 keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 gung1 tung4 wui4 jik1.)
(The secret garden was no longer a secret, but became a shared memory for the two of them.)

幸運號碼

阿婆成日話，買餸嘅時候見到雀仔，就係好兆頭。
(aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 waa6, maai5 sung3 ge3 si4 hau6 gin3 dou2 zoek3 zai2, zau6 hai6 hou2 siu6 tau4.)
(Grandma always says that seeing birds while grocery shopping is a good omen.)

今日佢見到三隻麻雀仔喺菜檔上面跳跳紮，開心到不得了。
(gam1 jat6 keoi5 gin3 dou2 saam1 zek3 maa4 zoek3 zai2 hai2 coi3 dong3 soeng6 min6 tiu3 tiu3 zaat3, hoi1 sam1 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5.)
(Today, she saw three sparrows hopping on top of the vegetable stall and was overjoyed.)

佢即刻買咗張六合彩，揀咗三個字：三、六、九。
(keoi5 zik1 hak1 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 luk6 hap6 coi2, gaan2 zo2 saam1 go3 zi6: saam1, luk6, gau2.)
(She immediately bought a lottery ticket and chose three numbers: three, six, nine.)

點知開獎嗰晚，真係中咗頭獎！
(dim2 zi1 hoi1 zoeng2 go2 maan5, zan1 hai6 zung3 zo2 tau4 zoeng2!)
(Who knew that on the night of the draw, she actually won the first prize!)

阿婆笑到見牙唔見眼，話啲雀仔真係佢嘅幸運號碼。
(aa3 po4 siu3 dou3 gin3 ngaa4 m4 gin3 ngaan5, waa6 di1 zoek3 zai2 zan1 hai6 keoi5 ge3 hang6 wan6 hou6 maa5.)
(Grandma smiled so wide you couldn't see her eyes, saying the birds were truly her lucky numbers.)

神奇藥水

阿婆唔舒服，成日都咳。
(aa3 po4 m4 syu1 fuk6, sing4 jat6 dou1 hak1.)
(Grandma wasn't feeling well, and coughed all the time.)

佢去睇醫生，醫生話佢感冒。
(keoi5 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1, ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 gam2 mou6.)
(She went to see the doctor, and the doctor said she had a cold.)

醫生俾咗樽神奇藥水佢。
(ji1 sang1 bei2 zo2 zeon1 san4 kei4 joek6 seoi2 keoi5.)
(The doctor gave her a bottle of magical medicine.)

阿婆飲咗一啖，即刻跳起舞。
(aa3 po4 jam2 zo2 jat1 daam6, zik1 hak1 tiu3 hei2 mou5.)
(Grandma took a sip, and immediately started dancing.)

原來唔係藥水，係橙汁嚟㗎！
(jyun4 lai4 m4 hai6 joek6 seoi2, hai6 caang2 zap1 lai4 gaa3!)
(Turns out it wasn't medicine, it was orange juice!)

阿婆同貓

阿婆艾華最鍾意就係喺公園度睇貓仔玩。
(aa3 po4 ngaai3 waa4 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 zau6 hai6 hai2 gung1 jyun2 dou6 tai2 maau1 zai2 waan2.)
(Grandma Ava’s favorite thing to do is watch kittens play in the park.)

有一日，佢見到一隻白色嘅貓仔瞓喺張櫈上面，瞓得好甜。
(jau5 jat1 jat6, keoi5 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 baak6 sik1 ge3 maau1 zai2 fan3 hai2 zoeng1 dang3 soeng6 min6, fan3 dak1 hou2 tim4.)
(One day, she saw a white kitten sleeping sweetly on a bench.)

艾華行埋去，輕輕噉摸咗下貓仔個頭。
(ngaai3 waa4 haang4 maai4 heoi3, hing1 hing1 gam2 mo2 zo2 haa5 maau1 zai2 go3 tau4.)
(Ava walked closer and gently stroked the kitten's head.)

貓仔擘大眼，喵喵叫咗兩聲，好似多謝佢噉。
(maau1 zai2 maak3 daai6 ngaan5, miu1 miu1 giu3 zo2 loeng5 seng1, hou2 ci5 do1 ze6 keoi5 gam2.)
(The kitten opened its eyes wide, meowed twice, as if to thank her.)

之後，艾華每日都去公園探貓仔，仲帶埋魚仔俾佢食添。
(zi1 hau6, ngaai3 waa4 mui5 jat6 dou1 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 taam3 maau1 zai2, zung1 daai3 maai4 jyu2 zai2 bei2 keoi5 sik6 tim1.)
(After that, Ava went to the park every day to visit the kitten, and even brought it fish to eat.)

佢哋兩個變咗好朋友，日日都開開心心噉一齊玩。
(keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 bin3 zo2 hou2 pang4 jau5, jat6 jat6 dou1 hoi1 hoi1 sam1 sam1 gam2 jat1 cai4 waan2.)
(The two of them became good friends, and they played together happily every day.)

瞓晏覺嘅秘密

我今日起身，發覺隻貓仔瞓喺我個頭上面。
(ngo5 gam1 jat6 hei2 san1, faat3 gok3 zek3 maau1 zai2 fan3 hai2 ngo5 go3 tau4 soeng6 min6.)
(I woke up today and found a kitten sleeping on my head.)

佢好得意咁望住我，好似話：「你終於醒啦！」
(keoi5 hou2 dak1 ji3 gam2 mong5 zyu6 ngo5, hou2 ci5 waa6: "nei5 zung1 jyu1 seng2 laa1!")
(It looked at me adorably, as if saying, "You're finally awake!")

落街買嘢食，撞到隔離屋嘅陳婆婆，佢請我食糖。
(lok6 gaai1 maai5 je5 sik6, zong6 dou2 gaak3 lei4 uk1 ge3 can4 po4 po4, keoi5 ceng2 ngo5 sik6 tong2.)
(I went downstairs to buy food and ran into Grandma Chan from next door, who offered me candy.)

返到屋企，發現我阿媽偷偷地將我啲玩具擺晒入櫃桶。
(faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2, faat3 hin3 ngo5 aa3 maa1 tau1 tau1 dei6 zoeng1 ngo5 di1 waan2 geoi6 baai2 saai3 jap6 gwai6 tung2.)
(When I got home, I discovered that my mom had secretly put all my toys in the drawer.)

夜晚我夢見自己變成咗超人，拯救緊全世界嘅貓仔！
(je6 maan5 ngo5 mung6 gin3 zi6 gei2 bin3 sing4 zo2 ciu1 jan4, cing2 gau3 gan2 cyun4 sai3 gaai3 ge3 maau1 zai2!)
(At night I dreamt I became a superhero, saving all the kittens in the world!)

點心奇遇

阿婆今朝去飲茶，諗住食返籠蝦餃。
(aa3 po4 gam1 zaau1 heoi3 jam2 caa4, nam2 zyu6 sik6 faan1 lung4 haa1 gaau2.)
(Grandma went to have dim sum this morning, thinking of eating a basket of har gow.)

點知打開蒸籠，啲蝦餃竟然識得講嘢！
(dim2 zi1 daa2 hoi1 zing1 lung4, di1 haa1 gaau2 ging2 jin4 sik1 dak1 gong2 je5!)
(But when she opened the steamer basket, the har gow could actually talk!)

佢哋話想同阿婆一齊去公園玩滑梯。
(keoi5 dei6 waa6 soeng2 tung4 aa3 po4 jat1 cai4 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 waan2 waat6 tai1.)
(They said they wanted to go to the park with Grandma to play on the slide.)

阿婆覺得好得意，就帶咗佢哋去。
(aa3 po4 gok3 dak1 hou2 dak1 ji3, zau6 daai3 zo2 keoi5 dei6 heoi3.)
(Grandma thought it was very interesting, so she took them.)

喺公園，啲蝦餃吱吱喳喳，玩得好開心。
(hai2 gung1 jyun2, di1 haa1 gaau2 zi1 zi1 caa1 caa1, waan2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.)
(At the park, the har gow chattered and played happily.)

阿婆見到佢哋咁開心，自己都笑到見牙唔見眼。
(aa3 po4 gin3 dou3 keoi5 dei6 gam3 hoi1 sam1, zi6 gei2 dou1 siu3 dou3 gin3 ngaa4 m4 gin3 ngaan5.)
(Seeing them so happy, Grandma smiled so wide you couldn't see her eyes.)

臨走嗰陣，啲蝦餃仲唔捨得阿婆，話下次再一齊玩。
(lam4 zau2 go2 zan6, di1 haa1 gaau2 zung6 m4 se2 dak1 aa3 po4, waa6 haa6 ci3 zoi3 jat1 cai4 waan2.)
(When it was time to leave, the har gow were reluctant to part with Grandma, saying they wanted to play together again next time.)

打風都唔落雨

阿婆行入茶餐廳，笑眯眯咁講：「早晨，靚仔！」
(aa3 po4 haang4 jap6 caa4 caan1 teng1, siu3 mi1 mi1 gam2 gong2: "zou2 san4, leng3 zai2!")
(The old woman walked into the tea restaurant, smiling and said, "Good morning, handsome!")

個伙計即刻醒神晒，應佢：「婆婆早晨，今日想食咩呀？」
(go3 fo2 gai2 zik1 hak1 sing2 san4 saai3, ying3 keoi5: "po4 po4 zou2 san4, gam1 jat6 soeng2 sik6 me1 aa3?")
(The waiter immediately perked up and replied, "Good morning, Grandma, what would you like to eat today?")

阿婆拎住張濕淋淋嘅報紙，細聲問：「可唔可以幫我影印一張呀？啲字花晒喇。」
(aa3 po4 ling1 zyu6 zoeng1 sap1 lam4 lam4 ge3 bou3 zi2, sai3 seng1 man6: "ho2 m4 ho2 ji3 bong1 ngo5 ying2 jan3 jat1 zoeng1 aa3? di1 zi6 faa1 saai3 laa3.")
(The old woman, holding a soggy newspaper, asked softly, "Could you help me photocopy this? The words are all blurred.")

伙計二話不說，嗱嗱聲幫佢搞掂。
(fo2 gai2 ji6 waa6 bat1 syut3, naa4 naa4 seng1 bong1 keoi5 gaau2 dim6.)
(The waiter didn't hesitate and quickly helped her get it done.)

阿婆笑到見牙唔見眼，話：「真係唔該晒你呀，好人一生平安！」
(aa3 po4 siu3 dou3 gin3 ngaa4 m4 gin3 ngaan5, waa6: "zan1 hai6 m4 goi1 saai3 nei5 aa3, hou2 jan4 jat1 sang1 ping4 on1!")
(The old woman smiled so wide you couldn't see her eyes, and said, "Thank you so much, may good people have peace for a lifetime!")

神奇嘅菠蘿包

阿婆今朝去咗茶餐廳，想買個熱辣辣嘅菠蘿包。
(aa3 po4 gam1 ziu1 heoi3 zo2 caa4 caan1 teng1, soeng2 maai5 go3 jit6 laat6 laat6 ge3 bo1 lo4 baau1.)
(Grandma went to the tea restaurant this morning, wanting to buy a piping hot pineapple bun.)

點知個菠蘿包識得講嘢，仲同阿婆講早晨！
(dim2 zi1 go3 bo1 lo4 baau1 sik1 dak1 gong2 je5, zung6 tung4 aa3 po4 gong2 zou2 san4!)
(Unexpectedly, the pineapple bun could talk, and even said "Good morning!" to Grandma!)

阿婆嚇到彈開，以為自己發緊夢。
(aa3 po4 haak3 dou3 daan6 hoi1, ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 faat3 gan2 mung6.)
(Grandma was so startled she jumped back, thinking she was dreaming.)

個菠蘿包笑咪咪咁話：「唔使驚，我係神奇菠蘿包！」
(go3 bo1 lo4 baau1 siu3 mi1 mi1 gam2 waa6: "m4 sai2 geng1, ngo5 hai6 san4 kei4 bo1 lo4 baau1!")
(The pineapple bun smiled and said: "Don't be afraid, I'm a magical pineapple bun!")

阿婆試咗一啖，即刻後生咗十年！
(aa3 po4 si3 zo2 jat1 daam6, zik1 hak1 hau6 saang1 zo2 sap6 nin4!)
(Grandma tried a bite, and instantly became ten years younger!)

從此之後，茶餐廳嘅菠蘿包就出曬名，大家都想試下變後生嘅滋味。
(cung4 ci2 zi1 hau6, caa4 caan1 teng1 ge3 bo1 lo4 baau1 zau6 ceot1 saai3 ming4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 soeng2 si3 haa5 bin3 hau6 saang1 ge3 zi1 mei6.)
(From then on, the tea restaurant's pineapple buns became famous, and everyone wanted to try the taste of becoming younger.)

神奇燒賣

阿婆喺街市賣燒賣，啲燒賣識得講嘢㗎！
(aa3 po4 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai6 siu1 maai2, di1 siu1 maai2 sik1 dak1 gong2嘢 gaa3!)
(The grandma sells siu mai in the market, and those siu mai can talk!)

有日，有個細路仔想買，燒賣就話：「唔好食我呀，我仲想睇卡通片！」
(jau5 jat1 jat6, jau5 go3 sai3 lou6 zai2 soeng2 maai5, siu1 maai2 zau6 waa6: "m4 hou2 sik6 ngo5 aa3, ngo5 zung6 soeng2 tai2 kaa1 tung1 pin3!")
(One day, a kid wanted to buy them, and the siu mai said, "Don't eat me, I still want to watch cartoons!")

細路仔嚇到呆咗，阿婆笑咪咪咁話：「傻仔，燒賣講笑啫！」
(sai3 lou6 zai2 haak3 dou3 ngoi4 zo2, aa3 po4 siu3 mi1 mi1 gam2 waa6: "so4 zai2, siu1 maai2 gong2 siu3 ze1!")
(The kid was so scared he froze, and the grandma said with a smile: "Silly boy, the siu mai are just joking!")

佢買咗一粒，點知食落肚，聽到把聲話：「好味！」
(keoi5 maai5 zo2 jat1 lap1, dim2 zi1 sik6 lok6 tou5, teng1 dou2 baa2 seng1 waa6: "hou2 mei6!")
(He bought one, and unexpectedly, after eating it, he heard a voice saying, "Delicious!")

原來啲燒賣真係有靈性，不過食咗佢哋都會覺得開心。
(jyun4 loi4 di1 siu1 maai2 zan1 hai6 jau5 ling4 sing3, bat1 gwo3 sik6 zo2 keoi5 dei6 dou1 wui5 gok3 dak1 hoi1 sam1.)
(Turns out the siu mai really had a spirit, but eating them made them happy.)

**街市奇遇記**

阿婆行入街市，諗住買啲靚菜煮飯。  
(aa3 po4 haang4 jap6 gaai1 si5, nam2 zyu6 maai5 di1 leng3 coi3 zyu2 faan6.)  
(Grandma walked into the market, thinking of buying some nice vegetables to cook dinner.)

點知佢見到一檔菜，啲菜識得唱歌！  
(dim2 zi1 keoi5 gin3 dou2 jat1 dong3 coi3, di1 coi3 sik1 dak1 cheung3 go1!)  
(Unexpectedly, she saw a vegetable stall where the vegetables knew how to sing!)

棵菜仔唱住：「阿婆，買我啦，我好甜㗎！」  
(po1 coi3 zai2 cheung3 zyu6: "aa3 po4, maai5 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 hou2 tim4 gaa3!")  
(The little vegetable sang, "Grandma, buy me, I'm very sweet!")

阿婆笑到咔咔聲，覺得好得意。  
(aa3 po4 siu3 dou3 kaa1 kaa1 seng1, gok3 dak1 hou2 dak1 ji3.)  
(Grandma laughed heartily, finding it very amusing.)

佢買咗好多唱歌菜，諗住煮俾孫仔食。  
(keoi5 maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 cheung3 go1 coi3, nam2 zyu6 zyu2 bei2 syun1 zai2 sik6.)  
(She bought a lot of singing vegetables, thinking of cooking them for her grandson to eat.)

返到屋企，啲菜仲唱緊歌，成間屋都好熱鬧！  
(faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2, di1 coi3 zung6 cheung3 gan2 go1, seng4 gaan1 uk1 dou1 hou2 jit6 naau6!)  
(Back home, the vegetables were still singing, making the whole house lively!)

秋葉的秘密

一片紅葉仔跌咗落嚟，發現自己識得講嘢喇！
(jat1 pin3 hung4 jip6 zai2 dit3 zo2 lok6 lai4, faat3 jin6 zi6 gei2 sik1 dak1 gong2 je5 laa3!)
(A little red leaf fell down and discovered it could talk!)

佢好驚訝，周圍問其他葉仔點解。
(keoi5 hou2 ging1 ngaa6, zau1 wai4 man6 kei4 taa1 jip6 zai2 dim2 gai2.)
(It was very surprised and asked the other leaves why.)

有片黃葉笑住咁話：「因為秋天到咗囉，我哋有魔法㗎！」
(jau5 pin3 wong4 jip6 siu3 zeoi6 gam2 waa6: "jan1 wai6 cau1 tin1 dou3 zo2 lo3, ngo5 dei6 jau5 mo1 faat3 gaa3!")
(A yellow leaf smiled and said, "Because autumn has arrived, we have magic!")

紅葉仔試吓大叫：「我想飛返上去啊！」
(hung4 jip6 zai2 si3 haa5 daai6 giu3: "ngo5 soeng2 fei1 faan1 soeng5 heoi3 aa!")
(The little red leaf tried shouting, "I want to fly back up!")

突然間，一陣風吹嚟，佢又飛返上樹喇！
(dat1 jin4 gaan1, jat1 zan6 fung1 cheoi1 lai4, keoi5 jau6 fei1 faan1 soeng5 syu6 laa3!)
(Suddenly, a gust of wind blew, and it flew back up the tree!)

圖書館奇遇

阿婆行入圖書館，想借本食譜。
(aa3 po4 haang4 jap6 tou4 syu1 gun2, soeng2 ze3 bun2 sik6 pu2.)
(An old woman walked into the library, wanting to borrow a cookbook.)

點知一打開，裡面竟然跌咗隻識講嘢嘅小老鼠出嚟！
(dim2 zi1 jat1 daa2 hoi1, lei5 min6 ging2 jin4 dit3 zo2 zek3 sik1 gong2 je5 ge3 siu2 lou5 syu2 chut1 lai4!)
(But when she opened it, a talking little mouse fell out!)

隻老鼠話佢住喺書裡面，專門幫人搵好味嘅食譜。
(zek3 lou5 syu2 waa6 keoi5 zyu6 hai2 syu1 lei5 min6, zyun1 mun4 bong1 jan4 wan2 hou2 mei6 ge3 sik6 pu2.)
(The mouse said it lived inside the book and specialized in helping people find delicious recipes.)

阿婆覺得好得意，就同佢一齊研究點整最好味嘅蘿蔔糕。
(aa3 po4 gok3 dak1 hou2 dak1 ji3, zau6 tung4 keoi5 jat1 cai4 jin4 gau3 dim2 zing2 zeoi3 hou2 mei6 ge3 lo4 baak6 gou1.)
(The old woman found it very interesting, so she researched with it how to make the most delicious radish cake.)

結果，佢哋嘅蘿蔔糕食譜仲出埋書，成為圖書館嘅鎮館之寶！
(git3 gwo2, keoi5 dei6 ge3 lo4 baak6 gou1 sik6 pu2 zung2 chut1 maai4 syu1, sing4 wai4 tou4 syu1 gun2 ge3 zan3 gun2 zi1 bou2!)
(As a result, their radish cake recipe was even published as a book, becoming the library's treasure!)

月亮上的湯圓

阿婆話，中秋節嘅月光特別圓，好似一粒大湯圓。
(aa3 po4 waa6, zung1 cau1 zit3 ge3 jyut6 gwong1 dak6 bit6 jyun4, hou2 ci5 jat1 lap1 daai6 tong1 jyun2.)
(Grandma said that the Mid-Autumn Festival’s moonlight is especially round, like a big glutinous rice ball.)

我哋一家人喺天台賞月，食住月餅，傾偈。
(ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 hai2 tin1 toi4 soeng2 jyut6, sik6 zyu6 jyut6 beng2, king1 gai2.)
(My family and I were enjoying the moon on the rooftop, eating mooncakes, and chatting.)

突然，我見到月亮上面好似有隻玉兔跳跳紮。
(dat6 jin4, ngo5 gin3 dou2 jyut6 loeng4 soeng6 min6 hou2 ci5 jau5 zek3 juk6 tou3 tiu3 tiu3 zaat3.)
(Suddenly, I saw a jade rabbit seemingly hopping on the moon.)

阿哥笑我發夢，話玉兔忙住整湯圓。
(aa3 go1 siu3 ngo5 faat3 mung6, waa6 juk6 tou3 mong4 zyu6 zing2 tong1 jyun2.)
(My older brother laughed at me for dreaming, saying the jade rabbit was busy making glutinous rice balls.)

我哋一齊望住月亮，想像住月亮上面嘅湯圓工場。

(aa3 po4 maai6 jyu2 daan2 maai6 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4, di1 jyu2 daan2 dak6 bit6 hou2 sik6.)
(The grandma has been selling fishballs for many years, and her fishballs are especially delicious.)

原來佢加咗秘密武器，就係少少陳皮同埋薑汁。
(jyun4 loi4 keoi5 gaa1 zo2 bei3 mat6 bou2 hei3, zau6 hai6 siu2 siu2 can4 pei4 tung4 maai4 goeng1 zap1.)
(Turns out she adds a secret weapon, which is a little dried tangerine peel and ginger juice.)

啲街坊成日排隊買，為咗食到阿婆嘅獨門秘方。

有日，有個細路仔問阿婆：「點解你嘅魚蛋咁好食㗎？」
(jau5 jat6, jau5 go3 sai3 lou6 zai2 man6 aa3 po4: "dim2 gaai2 nei5 ge3 jyu2 daan2 gam3 hou2 sik6 gaa3?")
(One day, a little boy asked the grandma, "Why are your fishballs so delicious?")

阿婆笑笑口話：「秘密嚟㗎，不過最緊要用心去做！」
(aa3 po4 siu3 siu3 hau2 waa6: "bei3 mat6 lai4 gaa3, bat1 gwo3 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 jung6 sam1 heoi3 zou6!")
(The grandma smiled and said, "It's a secret, but the most important thing is to put your heart into it!")

街市奇遇

阿婆今日去街市買餸，點知見到一隻識講嘢嘅橙。
(aa3 po4 gam1 jat6 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 sung3, dim2 zi1 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 sik1 gong2 je5 ge3 caang2.)
(Grandma went to the market today to buy groceries, but unexpectedly saw an orange that could talk.)

隻橙用好得意嘅聲話：「阿婆，買我啦，我好甜㗎！」

阿婆覺得好搞笑，就買咗佢返屋企。
(aa3 po4 gok3 dak1 hou2 gaau2 siu3, zau6 maai5 zo2 keoi5 faan1 uk1 kei2.)

返到屋企，隻橙仲同阿婆講故仔，氹到阿婆好開心。

原來，呢隻橙係一個仙子變嘅，佢想帶俾阿婆快樂。

拳套奇遇

阿婆今日去街市買餸，見到地上有對拳套。
(aa3 po4 gam1 jat6 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 sung3, gin3 dou2 dei6 soeng6 jau5 deoi3 kyun4 tou3.)

佢諗住執返屋企，睇下邊個唔見咗。

點知對拳套一掂到佢隻手，突然間識講嘢！
(dim2 zi1 deoi3 kyun4 tou3 jat1 dim1 dou3 keoi5 zek3 sau2, dat6 jin4 gaan1 sik1 gong2 je5!)

拳套話：「阿婆，我哋帶你返後生，去打拳！」

阿婆嚇到彈開，但係又覺得好刺激，於是就應承咗。

佢哋一齊參加咗拳擊比賽，阿婆打到啲後生仔嘩嘩聲，勁過李小龍！
(keoi5 dei6 jat1 cai4 caam1 gaa1 zo2 kyun4 gik1 bei2 coi3, aa3 po4 daa2 dou3 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 waa1 waa1 seng1, ging6 gwo3 lei5 siu2 lung4!)

最後阿婆贏咗冠軍，對拳套就變返普通嘅拳套，靜靜雞喺佢嘅櫃桶入面。
(zeoi3 hau6 aa3 po4 wing4 zo2 gun1 gwan3, deoi3 kyun4 tou3 zau6 bin3 faan1 pou2 tung1 ge3 kyun4 tou3, zing6 zing6 gai1 hai2 keoi5 ge3 gwai6 tung2 jap6 min6.)
(In the end, Grandma won the championship, and the gloves turned back into ordinary boxing gloves, quietly sitting in her drawer.)

採蜜奇遇

點知返到屋企打開盒士多啤梨，啲蜜蜂仔變咗好多好多。

佢哋圍住阿婆跳舞，仲送咗好多蜜糖俾阿婆。
(Keoi5 dei6 wai4 zyu6 aa3 po4 tiu3 mou5, zung6 sung3 zo2 hou2 do1 mat6 tong4 bei2 aa3 po4.)

原來，佢哋係士多啤梨嘅守護者，多謝阿婆救咗佢哋。
(Jyun4 lai4, keoi5 dei6 hai6 si6 do1 be1 lei2 ge3 sau2 wu6 ze2, do1 ze6 aa3 po4 gau3 zo2 keoi5 dei6.)

傻貓阿咪去飲茶

點心車一到，佢就伸長條頸，眼金金咁望住啲蝦餃。

婆婆見到佢咁想食，就偷偷哋夾咗粒蝦餃畀佢。
(po4 po2 gin3 dou2 keoi5 gam3 soeng2 sik6, zau6 tau1 tau1 dei2 gaap3 zo2 lap1 haa1 gaau2 bei2 keoi5.)

阿咪食到舔舔脷，覺得好開心，下次都想再去飲茶！
(aa3 mi1 sik6 dou3 tim2 tim2 lei2, gok3 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1, haa6 ci3 dou1 soeng2 zoi3 heoi3 jam2 caa4!)

貓咪嘅秘密花園

阿婆養咗隻肥嘟嘟嘅貓仔，成日喺屋企瞓覺。
(aa3 po4 joeng5 zo2 zek3 fei4 du1 du1 ge3 maau1 zai2, seng4 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei2 fan3 gaau3.)

有一日，貓仔偷偷哋打開咗後花園嘅門。
(jau5 jat1 jat6, maau1 zai2 tau1 tau1 dei2 daa2 hoi1 zo2 hau6 faa1 jyun4 ge3 mun4.)
(One day, the cat secretly opened the door to the backyard.)

佢發現咗一個充滿蝴蝶同埋花嘅秘密花園！
(keoi5 faat3 jin6 zo2 jat1 go3 cung1 mun5 wu4 dip6 tung4 maai4 faa1 ge3 bei3 mat6 faa1 jyun4!)

阿婆見到貓仔咁開心，都忍唔住笑出聲。
(aa3 po4 gin3 dou2 maau1 zai2 gam3 hoi1 sam1, dou1 jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3 chut1 seng1.)

藍鳥嘅秘密花園

有隻藍鳥仔，佢有個秘密嘅花園。
(jau5 zek3 laam4 niu5 zai2, keoi5 jau5 go3 bei3 mat6 ge3 faa1 jyun4.)

花園入面種滿晒五顏六色嘅花，好靚㗎！

佢成日喺花度唱歌仔，開心到不得了。
(keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 faa1 dou6 coeng3 go1 zai2, hoi1 sam1 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5.)

有一日，佢發現花園入面多咗一隻受傷嘅蝴蝶。

藍鳥仔好細心噉照顧蝴蝶，直到佢康復。

結果，藍鳥仔嘅花園變得更加繽紛燦爛喇！
(git3 gwo2, laam4 niu5 zai2 ge3 faa1 jyun4 bin3 dak1 gang3 gaa1 ban1 fan1 caan3 laan6 laa3!)
(As a result, the little blue jay's garden became even more colourful and vibrant!)

捉錯貓

(aa3 po4 gam1 ziu1 hei2 san1, lam2 zyu6 lok6 gaai1 maai5 sung3.)

點知一開門，就見到兩個警察叔叔企喺門口。

佢哋好客氣咁問：「婆婆，你係咪養咗隻貓？」

阿婆話：「係呀，佢成日偷食我啲鹹魚！」

阿婆同佢哋講：「唔使捉啦，佢食飽咗就自己返嚟！」
(aa3 po4 tung4 keoi5 dei6 gong2: "m4 sai2 zuk1 laa1, keoi5 sik6 baau2 zo2 zau6 zi6 gei2 faan1 lai4!")

捉錯貓

 suddenly, 一隻貓仔跳上阿婆嘅膊頭，好似想同佢講嘢咁。

阿德覺得自己好似執到寶咁，開心咗成日。
